title: Marriage of Convenience: I Wed My First Love, The Pilot
description: Nora has loved Ethan since he stood up for her in high school. Ten years later, she's an air traffic controller, he's a pilot, and a blind date reunites them. When Ethan proposes a marriage of convenience, Nora agrees, keeping her feelings to herself. But after she guides his plane through a storm, a jealous colleague tries to destroy her career and their marriage. Can Nora clear her name and tell Ethan what she's kept secret for a decade?

title: War of the Divine Blood
description: A child born with both divine and demonic blood is secretly sent to Nanjing and raised by a group of fallen heroes. Believed to be powerless, Jinwoo grows up surrounded by love and sacrifice. When a ruthless ruler orders the extermination of all Nanjing's people, Jinwoo must uncover the truth of his origin, awaken his extraordinary strength, and fight to save his home from destruction.

title: The Mafia's Accidental Queen
description: Eun-soo gets unexpectedly pregnant due to a medical mix-up. Her initial shock is short-lived when she discovers the father of her unborn child is the ruthless Mafia King, Gio. Will Eun-soo accept Gio as her baby's father and become the Queen of the Mafia Empire?

title: Golden Dragon Mother’s Rampage
description:
In my past life, I was a pure-blooded white dragon who gave everything to help him seize the throne—only to have that hypocrite  Igon  sever my wings, steal my child, shatter my egg, and summon heavenly thunder to strike me down. With my dying breath, I swore on my blood: if I ever returned, I would make him pay a hundredfold!

I open my eyes to find myself back at the royal consort selection ceremony—the very day he chose my half-sister Jean  instead, and tried to ruin my name with a so-called "divine prophecy." Fine. I sneak straight into the forbidden depths and claim the legendary ancient Golden Dragon, Cedric, as my mate—conceiving the supreme dragon heir!

The scumbag gloats as his egg hatches a golden dragon, taunting me that my black egg could only produce a lowly black dragon. But when my egg cracks open—a rainbow-colored Supreme Saint Dragon emerges, crushing his shadowy black dragon whelp in an instant! With our bet sealed, I raise my blade and sever his wings, ripping off his false golden dragon disguise for all to see—

Wait. The "black dragon" mate I picked up on a whim… is the undisputed pinnacle of all dragonkind?!

"My dear, for the sake of saving dragon bloodline, we'll just have to try a few more times." He chuckles, pulling me closer by the waist.

This rebirth? Totally worth it.

description: La famille Durand retrouve sa vraie fille et chasse Mélanie Durand de la maison. Son mari nominal est parti à l'étranger avec sa maîtresse. title: Flame of Love
description: The original owner, Qu Yan, is the heroine of a tragic drama. In order to save her, the quick-travel host Qu Yan descended on the original owner, divorced a violent scumbag, and started a romantic love affair with Mr. Yan, which brought about subversive changes in the original owner's life.

title: Billionaire in Disguise: Daddy Edition
description: Clara Monroe, a single mother of two, is reluctantly dragged by her son to a blind date—only to unexpectedly run into Ryan Pierce, the father of her children and one of the wealthiest men in the world. In a surprising twist, they soon find themselves married. As they navigate life together, Ryan—disguised as a humble deliveryman—begins to realize that Clara and their children are the ones he cherishes most in the world.

title: Martial Supreme: The Revelation of a Hidden Identity
description: Jiang Ziling, the youngest master in the academy's history, hid his identity and became the Ye family's son-in-law. As misunderstandings and conflicts with his wife Ye Yunyun continue to escalate, Jiang Ziling's identity is gradually exposed...

title: In Love, In Silence
description:
"Queenie James lost her parents at a young age and was left to suffer under the cruel hands of her uncle and aunt. She managed to get into university—only to face new hardships due to her poverty and inability to speak.A chance encounter brought Harrison Fletcher, a cold and powerful CEO, into her life. Moved by her resilience, he stepped into her world and offered her a way out.
In Harrison's world, Queenie found something she had never dared to hope for: care, respect, and a family that accepted her for who she was. As their bond deepened, she learned that even those without a voice could be heard—when someone truly listened."

title: Wolf Warrior
description: A Chinese special force soldier with extraordinary marksmanship is confronted by a group of deadly foreign mercenaries who are hired to assassinate him by a vicious drug lord.

title: Jaan-E-Bahaar
description: Kuku Rai belongs to a wealthy family, and lives with her businessman dad and housewife mom. Since she is of marriageable age, her parents want her to get married to a young man named Ajit, who also comes from a wealthy family. But romantic and adventurous Kuku refuses to do so, and runs away from home. On the run she meets with a truck-driver named Gopal alias Gopi and both of them fall in love with each other. Then Kuku finds herself locked in a barn, and after a few days the door is opened by none other than her dad, who tells her that Gopal had claimed a ransom of Rs.17,000/- for her safe release. Subdued, after her tryst with romance, Kuku agrees to marry Ajit. But fate has other plans for her, when she finds out that Mr. and Mrs. Rai are not her biological parents, but they may have sired a young man who they decided to abandon years ago. The question remains, will Kuku's marriage take place with Ajit now; will she ever come to know who her real parents are; and who exactly is the son of Mr. and Mrs. Rai.

title: Deedar-E-Yaar
description: Two close and devout Muslim youth, Javed and Akhtar, are childhood pals. They both unknowingly fall in love with the same woman, Firdaus. Since Akhtar is wealthy, and comes from a noble family, the girl's dad, Nawab Mirza, decides that she should marry Akhtar. She is reluctant to do so, but finally agrees when she is threatened. Akhtar has not yet seen Firdaus, but finds out that Javed also loves her, and he decides to marry her, and promptly divorce her by saying "Talaq" three times, so that Javed can marry her later. Javed is delighted with this idea and goes along with it, not knowing that Firdaus is Akhtar's dreamgirl, and he may not be able to keep his word and divorce her.

title: Khakestar-e sabz
description: Hadi travels to Croatia to complete his researches on Film making. His friend Aziz who has heard about his trip gives him a photo and a VHS cassette asking him to look after a girl Fatemeh there. Hadi with the help of a woman Hanifeh who can talk Persian searches for the girl. Croatian police arrest Hadi and because of his visa problems expelled him from the country. He then with Hanifeh go to Bosnia to complete his search after Fatemeh but involved in the Bosnia's war and get injured.

title: Noor e Zindagi
description: When Noor, a beautiful and educated girl marries Saleem a grocery store owner, differences begin to surface between the two. In efforts to save her marriage will Noor be appreciated by Saleem or will he continue to ill-treat her.

title: Dokhtar-e Sheytan
description: The story of the devil's daughter who is seeking for God's forgiveness, comes to earth to find a way to make up for what her father has done. Trying to find a medium to compensate for her dad's wrongdoings, she finds a man who must help her.

title: Amor e Sangue
description: Sophia parte em busca da irmã gêmea desaparecida, Tina. As pistas a conduzem ao Véu Rubro, um exclusivo clube noturno para vampiros controlado pela implacável família Von Drák. Ao entrar nesse mundo sombrio e sedutor, Sophia descobre uma profecia assustadora, um romance proibido e uma guerra sobrenatural que ameaça destruir a todos.

title: Roz-e zard
description: Davood and Leili in their wedding night travel to the north. In the way they meet another couple Mahshid and Arash and accompany them to the north. But Arash had an accident with a black suit man. With the help of Davood he throws the body in a swamp but this is only the beginning of their problems.

title: Quebra e Reina
description: Matheus Silveira é o filho ilegítimo não reconhecido de Ricardo Nogueira, o chefe do crime. Para pagar a cirurgia de sua mãe, que tem uma doença terminal, ele aceita uma missão proposta por Ricardo e entra sozinho em um lugar extremamente perigoso. Mas ele não sabe que tudo isso é apenas um plano de Ricardo, e Matheus é só uma peça a ser descartada

title: Dio vede e provvede
description:
Amelia è una prostituta che ricercata dalla polizia si rifugia in convento. Nonostante scopra che la polizia non la cerca più, Amelia rimane in convento come Suor Amelia, decidendo di aiutare le suore e le bambine che queste accudiscono. Suor Amelia ha una sorella gemella, Giuditta, che crede vivere in Australia. Quest'ultima però (nella seconda stagione) rientrata in Italia, è fonte di incomprensioni, equivoci e guai per la religiosa.

La nuova serie comincia con un colpo di scena: Amelia ha una sorella gemella, Giuditta, una "poco di buono" che le creerà più di un problema. Giuditta, che Amelia crede in Australia, mentre in realtà si trova in carcere, deve assolutamente convincere la sorella, con le buone o con le cattive, a lasciare il convento. Infatti il miliardario zio d'America, Gastone, incallito mangiapreti, lascerà alle due gemelle un'eredità di un milione di dollari solo se Amelia desisterà dalla sua vocazione. Ecco quindi che Giuditta, alleatasi con un malavitoso soprannominato "il principe", le tenta tutte, a ogni puntata per fa sì che la sorella abbandoni o venga cacciata dal convento. Ma la gemella "cattiva" e il so complice sono manigoldi pasticcioni e di terz'ordine, combinano guai a ogni complotto e le trame da loro ordite si rivelano molto spesso controproducenti.

title: Traída e Vingada
description: Gwen Goodall confundiu Genzo Storey com seu salvador e fez de tudo para ajudá-lo a ganhar a coroa, mas ele a retribuiu com traição e matou toda a sua família. Após pular para a morte, Gwen se viu de volta três anos atrás! Determinada a reescrever o destino, ela procurou o deposto Príncipe Herdeiro Eugene. Enquanto o ajudava a recuperar o trono, descobriu uma verdade chocante—Eugene era seu verdadeiro salvador! Agora, Gwen estava pronta para virar o jogo e fazer seus inimigos pagarem!

title: When G-Men Step In
description: Fred Garth (Don Terry) owns a printing establishment and poses as a business research expert, but actually runs several white-collar rackets operating by means of high-pressure telephone soliciting. He has sent his younger brother, Bruce Garth (Robert Paige), through law school with the intention of making him his legal watch-dog. But idealist Bruce enrolls as a Department of Justice investigator, and is detailed to track down charity and other phoney rackets. Both brothers are in love with attractive socialite Marjorie Drake (Julie Bishop as Jacqueline Wells), who is unaware of Fred's schemes and he uses her to meet other social leaders with pet charities and his salesmen sell them the program ads at five times the charity rate. Bruce and his partner Neale (Gene Morgan) trace the phone rackets to Bruce and a confrontation looms.

title: Milky G
description:
Michael Farlow (Milky G), like a lot of teens from the new millennium, aspire to be rappers; however growing up on the streets of Los Angeles in a crime infested neighborhood, played against Milky's goal of making it big. After witnessing his mother getting killed during a drug raid, the trauma lingers in his mind as several years pass. Milky moves out of his old neighborhood and into the suburbs entering a new charter high school of mostly white students.

Milky G meets a girl [SANDY HOLMES] in his class, a classical music major, who he falls in lust with. She gets him into the schools "world talent show", but Milky G can't stay away from the old neighborhood and ghetto friends. The relationship gets stormy. Milky G rejects the boogie world and while suppressing the pain of his mother's memory, continues to hang out, run the streets, make fast money, and craft his rapper identity. Milky's behavior and bad attitude lead to constant clashes with the police and court appearances. Milky makes a rap demo for the talent show with the help of Big Stack, studio owner, a legend in his own right in the world of hip-hop. Big Stack, knowing Milky's past - becomes his mentor.

Although Milky is focused on his music, he can't stay away from a life of crime. He needs some flash money so he can acquire that rapper look and get his props at the talent show. This all comes to a head when Milky G is talked into robbing a drug dealers house and it doesn't go good. Gangsters are after him and the police are too. Weary, and with nowhere to turn, Milky G. leans on what Big Stack taught him about life and decides to undo the harm he's done to himself and others. Repentant, he ends up at his mother's grave begging for forgiveness and promising to make things right. Although he's been scratched from the talent show, he forces his way onto the stage to give a rap tribute to his mother. The crowd goes wild, but he doesn't win. Milky G gains SANDY's favor as well as those close to him who want him to take a different path and become the man he was meant to be. Risking his life he decides to return the stolen goods to the thugs.

title: Mythos Ot(h)ello
description: Kaum einer hatte wohl noch mit einem solchen Spätwerk von Giuseppe Verdi gerechnet: Als 1887 die Uraufführung von "Otello" stattfand, hatte er 16 Jahre lang keine Oper mehr geschrieben. Warum hatte Verdi sich ausgerechnet von der Geschichte des schwarzen Generals, der Opfer einer Intrige wird und aus falscher Eifersucht seine Frau ermordet, angezogen gefühlt? Shakespeares Dramenvorlage "Othello" ist sicherlich eines der größten Meisterwerke der Theatergeschichte. Aus heutiger Sicht ist es spannend und erhellend zu ergründen, was die beiden Meister ihres Fachs an einem schwarzen Titelhelden faszinierte und wie sie mit ihm umgehen. Welche Rolle spielten Schwarze in der Welt, in der Shakespeare und Verdi lebten? Welchen Einfluss hatte der Hintergrund des Kolonialzeitalters, das in England in Shakespeares Epoche und in Italien zu Verdis Lebzeiten anbrach? Wie wurde dieser erste schwarze Titelheld der Theater- und Operngeschichte seither dargestellt und was sagt das über die Vorstellung "Weißer" von "Schwarzen" aus? Diesen Fragen widmet sich die ARTE-Dokumentation "Mythos Ot(h)ello". Jonas Kaufmann und Antonio Pappano führen durch Verdis geniales Musikdrama. Experten und Expertinnen beleuchten die historischen Hintergründe sowohl der Oper wie Shakespeares Stücks. Fußballlegende Jimmy Hartwig, der nach seiner Sportlerlaufbahn eine Karriere als Schauspieler machte, erzählt, was Ot(h)ello mit seiner Rassismuserfahrung und seinem Leben zu tun hat.

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

title: Neighborhood Witch J
description: A star in the world of internet content creation, Seo Je Yi (Park Ji Yeon) has made quite a name for herself as a beauty expert. A smooth talker who isn't afraid to tell it like it is, Je Yi has amassed an impressive following since the start of her career and the numbers just keep rising. With so many dedicated followers, companies are beginning to take notice of Je Yi, including Lee Woo Bin (Lee Tae Sun), the CEO of a cosmetics start-up company whose products Je Yi has acknowledged on more than one occasion. A highly intelligent man, Lee Woo Bin knows what it takes to run a company well but when it comes to social interaction, he has absolutely no idea what he's doing. Encouraged by Je Yi's glowing reviews of his products, Woo Bin has tried, on more than one occasion, to get better acquainted with the rising star, but every attempt he has made so far has failed miserably. Meanwhile, Lee Tae Kyung (Jang Eui Soo), the director of MCN, a company specializing in managing content creators, has taken a sudden interest in Je Yi and he's determined to win her over. With so many roads now opening before her, Je Yi must decide which path will lead to both her success and happiness. But which path should she choose when her head tells her to go one way and her heart tells her to go another? The first selection for the 2020 pilot division of the Broadcasting Content Production Support Project, "Next Door Witch J" is a 2021 Viki Original romantic drama directed by Yoon Ji Hoon.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas [Hindi]
description: "Four Hands" is a piano term that refers to a technique where two people play a single piano together. The drama will depict the friendship, love, rivalry, and growth of youths who meet at an arts high school, following their journey from adolescence to adulthood as professional pianists. Set in an arts high school, the series follows Kang Bi-o, Chae Jeong-yo, and Jae-in as they grow from their school days into adulthood.

title: K.O. Beast [English]
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: K-Town
description: Three couples. Two Reporters. One question. Why are East Asians so popular? Rochelle Evans ask this question after her friend Karen Blackwell loses her boyfriend of two years to an East Asian girl. The two set out to follow three East-Asian-including interracial couples for sixty days in their day to day lives to find out what is the secret to this phenomenon.

title: Music Bank K-Chart
description: Music Bank K-Chart is KBS's long-run music chart show that airs live every Friday. The Top 50 songs of the week are featured on K-Chart. Every week, various K-pop artists come on the show to showcase their music and dance moves. It's a concert of all the popular artists that you can watch in the comfort of your home. From newly debuted rookies, artists making a comeback from their hiatus, indie bands, globally recognized idol groups, and much more, they will be able to satisfy your needs for K-pop. With eye-catching performances and melody that will echo in your heart, this music festival can provide viewing pleasure for those who are not even familiar with K-pop. Tune in every week and pay attention to see which artist and song wins the most popular song of the week.

title: K: The Unknown
description: Sidney Page is a beautiful young nurse, the object of the romantic attentions of several young men in her small town. One of them, a mysterious fellow known as K, suddenly finds that the life of his rival for Sidney's hand depends upon his revealing the secret of his own past.

title: Special Agent K-7
description: Famous criminal lawyer Lester Owens wins the release of his client, Eddie Geller, when Geller's trial ends with a deadlocked jury. A short time later, Vince "Lanny" Landers, F.B.I. Special Agent K-7, returns home from a trip to Europe and is greeted by reporter Olive O'Day, who jokingly tries to convince him to tell her the real story behind his trip. Even though he wants to retire, Landers has agreed to help the F.B.I. crack down on organized crime. After Kennedy, one of Geller's jurors, is found dead with $500 in his pocket, Adams, Landers' supervisor, asks him to find Geller's boss. Hoping to question Geller, Landers accepts Olive's invitation to a party in honor of her and her fiance, Billy Westrop, which Owens is giving that evening at Geller's nightclub. At the club, Landers warns Geller that he will eventually go to jail and suggests that he testify against his boss in exchange for a lighter sentence. During the evening, Geller and Tony Black quarrel over Peppy, a singer who is in love with Tony; Silky Samuels demands payoff money from Geller for fixing the jury; Schmidt, a gambler, accuses Geller of running a crooked game; and Geller demands that Billy pay his gambling debt. Later, when Geller is found dead, all the men become suspects. Olive convinces her newspaper to allow her to follow the story. She recognizes one of Geller's busboys from Geller's trial and tells Landers, who questions him and learns that Geller murdered his father. Olive and Billy get married, but after Tony is found murdered and the police identify Billy's fingerprints on the murder weapon, he is arrested. To help the couple, Landers questions the remaining suspects and Owens agrees to defend Billy. At Billy's trial, Owens uncharacteristically fumbles the defense. Landers then testifies that the fingerprints on the gun were forgeries and forces Owens to admit that he committed the murders and framed Billy because he was in love with Olive. Landers suspicions were aroused when he learned that Owens was an accomplished engraver and thus was capable of forging Billy's fingerprints on the murder weapon.

title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: The Flute of Love [Starr. Chioma Chukwuka & Daniel K Daniel]
description: When the gods decree, who are we, mere mortals; to question the will of the gods. The movie flute of love possesses an unusual kind of epic story; a type done with rich vusuals, impassioned functionality aimed for a deeper impact on the targeted audience.In the movie, three great men have been nominated by the gods to perform the most challenging and unbelievable task which qualifies each of them to be selected as the royal groom for the beautiful amiable princess of the bride. As challenging and tough as their task appears, one man must eventually conquer against all odds. This masterpiece is indeed an overwhelming tale of surprise, discovery and reawakening. The gods do not make make errors and all destinies fall into their divine plan.

title: A Questionable Protagonist
description: The city of Los Angeles is heavily divided into two zones: rich and poor. Crime is at its peak in the poor zone. Ex-NAVY SEAL Kyle H. Holmes is a washed up drunk living in the rich zone, he was the face of the African war campaign. After stumbling into the poor zone Kyle soon finds himself killing all those who cause crime in the poor zone, this becomes Kyle's new source for adrenalin and purpose, with Kyle killing, gang members, rapists and drug dealers, he of course makes enemies, including the corrupt cops and the notorious drug and crime lord, cocaine n' coco pops.

title: Tale of A-rang

title: Pudhu Pudhu Arthangal
description: A singer (Bharathi) who is tricked into marriage by his mother-in-law, his wife (Gowri )is enormously possessive about his fame and his female fans. One day they encounter into a fight and he decides escape from home. On the way he meets someone in the bus who is also running from her life as a dancer because her husband forcefully lets her to prostitution. They both experience some random incidents together and meet an one old couple, who are still very much enjoying love and life. Eventually the old couple dies, and by watching the couple they fall in love themselves. Then Bharathi get a prank call from his PA that Gowri is ill so he returns back to home town with Jyothi. Gowri finds him with another woman and gets furious. She files for a divorce, informs media about Jyothi. Jyothi's husband gets this news comes to find Jyothi. One thing led to another Gowri finally become mentally unstable because of her own decisions. Bharathi visits her in the mental hospital with Jyothi. Jyothi then understands that Gowri really needs Bharathi and they belong to each other, Jyothi leaves Bharathi with her. Jyothi's husband becomes a cripple and understands his mistakes, reunites with jyothi in the end.

title: A Barefoot Dream
description: After a series of pipe dream ventures go belly up, retired pro soccer player Kim Won-kang happens to visit East Timor, where he finds children playing the game barefoot on rocky pitches. Sensing a new business opportunity on finding the country doesn't have a single sporting goods store, he embarks on a scheme to get rich quick by purveying athletic shoes to the unshod youngsters. Sadly, no one there can afford to pay $60 for a pair of shoes, even on a generous installment plan, and before he knows it, he is reduced to coaching a team of ragged 10-year-olds and prospects are looking grim.

title: Alibhabha
description: The city is being shaken by many heart-stopping crimes taking place at different places. Young women are being molested and killed with alarming frequency. Velu (Kreshna) helps his father Subramaniam (Prakash Raj) in stealing. Being seasoned thieves, they rob everything right from pins to cars. A spate of young women are murdered, and these developments rock the city. Thiagarajan (Azhagam Perumal), a tough cop, investigates the case. However, differences of opinions crop between the Police Commissioner (Biju Menon) and Thiagarajan. One day, Velu saves the commissioner from a meeting in order to steal the commissioner car's audio player, and gets acquainted with him. Velu then begins to fall for Janani (Janani), who works in a bank. One day, when Velu withdraws money, he is shocked to find the balance amount to be Rs. 5 Lakhs. It suddenly swells to Rs. 30 Lakhs and reaches Rs. 70 Lakhs. That is when Subramaniam realizes that this is no mere coincidence. Someone was smartly using them as a pawn to cover up for other more serious activities. They were being used as the 'third man', a pretty common term in criminal parlance. Before they realize, all of them are caught in the web that was laid out. Who laid it out, how and why and do they eventually come out of it forms Alibaba. Subramaniam comes to Velu's rescue and manages to find the reason behind it. When the family begins to find out the reason behind this act, it results in bloodshed and gore, eventually ending up in Velu coming across the killers of young women in the city.

title: Family Register
description: An aspiring animation writer carrying deep childhood wounds fights to reclaim her identity and achieve her dream of global success. Her journey collides with her mother, a proud former star cellist hiding painful secrets behind a flawless image, and a cheerful singing instructor searching for personal happiness after years of hardship. Bound by broken family ties, hidden pain, and the desire to start over, these three women struggle against prejudice and fate to discover the true meaning of family.

title: Company M: A Mob of Soldiers
description:
An independent film based on historical events in Alabama in the 1920s. Set in the era when coal miners fought for better lives and mine owners had government in their pockets, Company M tells the story of one mine workers death at the hands of soldiers, a single tale that distills a much larger truth.

In 1921, their trial was one of the greatest ever staged in the state of Alabama. Nine soldiers from Company M of the Alabama National Guard were charged with murder in the killing of a young Walker County miner. Company commander Sgt. Robert J. Lancaster and others were eventually convicted, then walked free after an appeals court overturned the verdicts. Every one of those soldiers, it is said, died an untimely death.

During a lengthy and sometimes violent strike by miners, a young man had been gruesomely killed by a group of active-duty soldiers. Company M of the Alabama National Guard was among several units called to quell the strike, which had attracted national attention.

The newspapers of the time called it "The Lynching of Willie Baird." The killing outrages the pro-union populace of Walker County. Arrayed against the miners and in support of the soldiers were the industrialists and mine owners who were committed to breaking the unions.

Two trials ended in mistrial. In his thir trial, Lancaster was convicted of second degree murder and sentenced to 18 years. Not long afterward, an appeals court threw out all the convictions and the soldiers walked free. The State of Alabama, having been through political and economic turmoil and wrenched by racial and class divisions, dropped the case and it faded into history. Kevin Wayne brings "Company M: A Mob of Soldiers" back from the events and the times to life.

title: Rock 'n Tokyo
description: Tokyo proposes several different levels of reality. You can find anything you can imagine there and at the same time get a new surprise at every corner. I chose to portray this amazing city through rock 'n roll music. The Japanese love and understand rock, a kind of music and a way of life they discovered during the American occupation, after World War II. Even if Japanese society still preaches uniformity and order, there is an important underground world, where people live more freely. This is the Tokyo I show in my movie. We follow 4 rock bands : Guitar Wolf, 3 good looking guys wearing black leather and sunglasses, a singer/guitar player with a devilish presence, a garage rock that is among the most intense and loudest ever heard and surprisingly- a contract with a big record company ; The 5678s, rock-a-billy queens with a wild 50s elegance who conquered the world with a memorable scene in Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill ; the Jet Boys, led by an extreme, crazy, border-less and exhibitionist singer/guitar player ; Nine, young guys who believe in success by music - when I first met them, they played in front of Shinjuku station as if it was the last concert of their lives. title: Enchi o Banco do Além até o Limite
description:
Com a chegada do Submundo, Daniel Soares, que morreu nesse mundo em sua vida passada, renasce antes do evento com uma interface de jogo. Usando dinheiro ritual, ele abastece completamente sua conta no Submundo, adquirindo riqueza ilimitada.

Quando o Submundo finalmente desce sobre o mundo, Daniel usa sua fortuna infinita para forjar três artefatos divinos, evolui sua classe de ferreiro de nível D para Ferreiro Divino e, após três evoluções, ascende ao posto de Deus Criador. No fim, ele derrota o chefe final do mundo do Submundo.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

title: Dalawang MAGKARIBAL na kandidata, nagtagpo sa Miss Q&A
description:
Wala pang Pasko pero may paunang bonus na ang Madlang People at Solid Showtimers. Tanggapin ninyo ang regalong crystal-clear birit ng “TNT” divas na sina Marielle Montellano, Lyka Estrella, Arvery Lagoring, at Carmelle Collado!

Koronang kumikinang ay ipuputong sa accla na sa chukchak ay magaling. Isa lang ang aangat, kaya dapat ang talak ay pak na pak. Mga beks, atack!

For today's video, rumampa at rumatsada sina AR Duque, Rafa Manalang Ileto, at Billy Labitan Yadao. Sa Tumpak Ganern, hindi puwedeng tama lang ang sagot, dapat mabilis din ang mga kamay sa pagpindot. Kinapos sa speed si Rafa, kaya sina AR at Billy ang umabante sa next mission nilang ma-impress ang buong nation sa Wit Lang round.

Nabunot ni Billy ang tanong na, “Okay lang ba maraming nafo-fall sa’yo pero kanal ka?” habang si AR naman ay napaisip sa playtime question na, “Okay lang ba titingalain ka ng marami pero butiki ka?”

Samantala, kung si Ryan Bang ang may bitbit ng bowl of questions, may espesyal na tanong din siya para kay hurado Max Collins. Tumapatang ang oppa at bumanat sa magandang hurado sa harap niya. 'Yung coffee invite, mukhang mauuwi pa sa dinner. Abangan ang susund na kabanata!

Mula Pasong Buaya 2, Imus, Cavite ang ating mga player! Sa Laro Laro Pick game area, swerte nila ay sana maging higher!

At sa Act-Song, "Tadhana" nga ba ang gumawa ng paraan para sina Ryan at Cianne Dominguez ay magkabalikan? At, walang babaeng pinag-aagawan for today's video, pero hindi pa rin magkasundo sina Darren Espanto at Brent Manalo.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay Rocky, ang player na umabante sa jackpot round. Kuwento niya, may pinagdadaanan ang pamilya dahil nawalan sila ng kuryente sa bahay. At dahil sa problemang ito, naging praktikal si Rocky at tinanggap ang P25,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Celeb Edition: Comediennes in their TALAK era!
description:
Tumibok ang puso ng Madlang People sa harana nina Wilbert Ross, Earl Agustin, Amiel Sol, at Rob Deniel. Maytoon pang performance from Carl Guevarra at Fitterkarma. Girl power naman ang sigaw nina Angela Ken at Mariah Deborah.

Sa araw na 'to, mga comediennes ang nag-face off sa entablado para sa Miss Q and A Celebrity Edition. They ate and left no crumbs, sa pasabog nilang wit, laugh trip ang outcome!

Mula sa kaharian ng mga engkatada, pumasok sa mundo ng mga tao si Ethel Booba aka Bathalumang Ethelia, at ang masasabi lang niya, "Uwa!" Beep! Beep! Tabi dahil walang preno, walang U-turn at walang atrasan ang pagtalak ni Alora Sasam aka Alora Boulevard Cubao.

Sweet like candy, fierce like a diva naman si Candy Pangilinan aka Candiva Lacrofasia. Fur real ang ganda ni Verna Periwinkle aka Shitsue Ramirez. Bringing her superpower sa pagpaatawa, join din sa chukchakan si Pokwang aka Pokwangderwomom.

Bago ang Wit Lang pasiklaban, ang mga kandidata napagod na agad sa bardagulan. Pero hindi pa rin nagpawindang sa mga playtime na katanungan. Mula sa lima, tatlo ang pumaslak sa Beklamation, sina Powang, Candy, at Ethel.

Sa Beklamation, hinarap nila ang iisang katanungan, "Ano ang kukumpleto sa 'yong pagkababae?" Sagot ni Pokwang, pamilya. Aruga naman ang kay Candy. At for the first time in Miss Q and A history, may isang kandidata na sumagot habang naka-earphones. Only Ethel can pull it off! At ang talak niya, naging buo ang pagkababae niya sa pagdating ng anak na si Michaela.

title: Vice, na-touch sa pamilyang binuo ni Miss Q&A Bong Bong
description:
Si Will Ashley, may bagong paborito? Na-miss daw ng ex-"PBB Collab" housemate ang Madlang People, kaya super happy siyang makabalik with good news and performance featuring his debut single na “Paborito.”

Classic OPM feels naman ang hatid ng isa pang bisita na si Ivy Violan, na thankful sa success ng OPM.

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng tatlong kandidatang nagbabalik para sa Resbakulawan round–sina Bong Bong Tagulao, Adam Lambert, at Manika.

Patunay si Bong Bong na hindi lamang iisa ang mukha ng masaya at mapagmahal na pamilya. Twenty-one years strong na ang pagsasama nila ng partner, at may dalawa na silang anak. Ipinakilala ni Bong Bong ang partner at anak kay Vice Ganda, na na-touch dahil proud na proud sina Bong Bong sa binuong ‘modern family.’

Mula sa nakakaantig na kuwentuhan, balik-talak naman ang mga kandidata nang sumabak sila sa Wit Lang round at bumunot ng playtime questions.

Sina Adam at Manika ang umabante sa Beklamation round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, “Anong sa palagay mo ang naituturo ng pagkatalo na hindi naituturo ng panalo?”

Numero uno ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lalo na sa pagdating ng mga players na nagmula pa sa Concepcion I, Marikina.

Ang nag-emerge na numero uno sa mga challenges at laro ay walang iba kundi si player Isa, na rumaraket sa pamamagitan ng pagttitinda ng samu’t saring kutkutin. For today’s video, ang P350,000 POT money naman ang goal niyang kunin.

title: Ms. Castro umupo bilang Miss Q&A hurado
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Beauty ni Gibi, agaw-pansin sa Miss Q&A!
description:
Maningning ang pagsisimula ng Tuesday sa “It’s Showtime.” We choose happiness, and we choose a fun jamming with Jan Roberts at Lola Amour with their song "Tapos Na Ba Tayong Dalawa."

Times four ang tawanan dahil sanib-pwersa muli ang quadro nina Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro sa paboritong "It's Showtime" segment na Miss Q and A.

Times three naman ang wit at good vibes na dala nina candidates Labinya Winter, Valerie Evangelistar, at Gibi Esguerra who made the FUNanghalian extra interesting dahil sa mga talak nila na 'it's giving.'

Habang kinikilala ang mga kandidata, nalaman ni Vice Ganda angbpagkahilig ni Gibi sa luxury items, kaya hate niya si ‘judith.’ Payo naman ni Meme Vice, mag-impok lalo na sa kalusugan dahil walang tao na hindi nagkakasakit. Health is wealth, ‘ika nga.

Sa Wit Lang, sina Labinya at Gibi ang nag-face off. Dahil sa LOVE-an na LOVE-an niyang kasagutan, with lots of love na tinanggap ni Gibi ang korona as today's Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Make sure you are always smiling para dumapo ang blessing. POT question ay dapat masagot nang tama para ang premyong inaasam ay ma-achieve sa Laro Laro Pick. Tourism students ng NCR ang bumida sa game arena.

Si Maica, kabado for today’s video. Pero nawala ang kaba nang tabihan ni jowa. Madlang People ay kinilig kina Maica at Cris at sa kanilang kuwentong pag-ibig.

At ang harana ni player Ainsley, nauwi sa busking. Ang galing! Para bang may swerteng dala ang boses niya, dahil si Ainsley ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round. Tama ba ang napili niya?

title: Vice Ganda PINAUWI muna si Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Amats malala! EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nagpakilala sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Q: A Dark Comedy
description: All Guy needs is a friend. Cupid would normally be able to handle such an easy task, but with his recent addiction to hardcore prescription medication, he ends up turning every possible friend into victims of disturbing(ly funny) outcomes.

title: Incident at Channel Q
description: A quiet suburban neighborhood declares war on a heavy metal music DJ and his radio station, triggering an all-out war between the "metal heads" and the "straights."

title: R
description: In Los Angeles in 1965, unfulfilled B-list director Gordon Flemyng (Brad Pollak) receives the screenplay of a lifetime from his old friend Robert Sabaroff (Mark Baker), who is insistent they make a film that promises to entertain like no other. With football legend, turned actor, Jim Brown (J'amore Ward) attached to the picture, it seems the sky's the limit for these two filmmakers. Desperate to finally receive the recognition he's longed for, Gordon struggles to find the balance between passion and stardom. However, when Gordon pushes the MPAA rating guidelines of traditional cinema, he finds himself in a rabbit hole he's unsure he can escape from when his movie ("The Split" 1968) receives the first ever R-rating.

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: Ready o/r Rot
description: Guy and Heidi are finally headed for the altar, but pressure from Guy's mother creates so much friction between them that they wonder why they got married in the first place.

title: R-17
description: A new counselor at an all-girls school in Japan finds that her new workplace is a disaster area: not only are the students suffering through bullying, sexual harrassment, drug addiction and other problems, the teachers are having nervous breakdowns and the administrators don't want to hear a word of it. Number one on her problem list is a vicious sadist who also happens to be the headmaster's daughter. Will she be able to help turn the school around, or will she be crushed and spat out like her predecessors?

title: Boss, You're Busted!
description: Arthur blackmails Emma into helping him avoid his arranged marriage. She fulfills her end of the deal, but he ends up proposing on the spot to sell their charade. Emma ultimately agrees to avoid paying a hefty debt she owes him.

title: W.
description: A chronicle of the life and Presidency of George W. Bush.

title: You're Fired!!
description: An unemployed journalist and a recently fired Bouncer form a detective agency and then proceed to utterly bungle their first case: a bizarre mystery involving a murder of a milkman.

title: You're My Favorite Song
description: Angel, a brilliant girl, fights to build her dying grandfather's dream beach resort when a powerful empire targets their property. With classmates' help, she discovers friendship and first love while battling to save their legacy.

title: Dot-t
description: A deadly meteor strike on a planet in the distant galaxies brings destruction and the desperate escape of a young extraterrestrial in a space pod - and is forever separated from her mother and father. On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

Mike's unsympathetic boss, Bill, plays bad motivational tapes over the P.A., makes Mike's girlfriend (another employee) handle him during office hours, which is espied by co-worker Joni, and refuses to let Mike have the rest of the day off even though he is clearly ill. title: U Turn [Hindi]
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

The tricentenary of Skovoroda fell at the time of full-scale Russian aggression.

title: W
description:
W - If Woman is one of the words which comes to your mind, this movie is for you!

Open-minded, ambitious Sandhya Singh a.k.a Sandy (Leeza Mangaldas); Traditional, romantic Roohi Malik (Lezlie Tripathy) and Rebellious, lesbian (gay) Manu (Sonal Giani) are musicians & best friends forever (BFF) who run an event management company called W.

Short of funds and racing against time on their journey to organize their biggest music event yet The Freedom Concert they unexpectedly encounter The introvert, fanatic Abhay a.k,a. Bhaiji (Raaj Singh Arora); Mentally unstable Dhruv (Danish Pandor) & Womanizer Chotu (Abhay Attri). Although of good social standing, these men have issues with urbanization & modernity!

Not a battle of fists, W comes as a contemporary youthful musical thriller which explores the clash between the Women of Today and Men of Yesterday and how each side justifies their actions, words and mindset while setting an example for the rest of us without being preachy.

title: Mr. X, a Vision of Leos Carax
description: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. title: María y yo
description: María lives with her mother May, in the Canary Islands, 3,000 km from Barcelona, where Miguel Gallardo has his home. Sometimes Miguel and María go on holiday together, spending a week at a resort in southern Gran Canaria, a rather unusual setting where the guests don't normally include a single father and his fourteen year-old autistic daughter. This is the story of one of their journeys, but above all it's an original tale, full of humor, irony and sincerity, about how to live with a disability.

title: Trampas y caretas
description: Carmen Mackenna is a multimillionaire and obsessive mother who only wants to see her two children, now in their thirties, married and stable. For this, she will use all the tricks at her hand, which in this case took the form of an attractive woman, Mariana, to whom she entrusts the job of making them fall in love and taking the one she loves the most to the altar, in exchange for a generous monthly check.

title: Tumba y quema

title: Tierras y profundidades

title: History and Geography
description: Gioconda Martínez, a well-remembered comic television actress, decides to return to her hometown to stage a play about the conquest of Chile, which will allow her to regain the artistic recognition she thought she had lost, but never had.

title: Palo y hueso
description: An old man pays for a woman to live with him as his wife but soon discovers that she is sleeping with his son.

title: Amor y Frijoles
description: A typical story of Central American passion and the day to day lives of women who enjoy life, love and everything else.

title: The Problem Y

title: Fortunata y Jacinta
description: Shows the unfailing love of two women for the same man, one as his mistress, the other as his wife. The lives of these characters intertwine and are determined by the variegated fabric of delicate tradition and established vices shaky politics and intrigue of the society they live in. Based on the major novel (1877) by Benito Perez Galdos.

title: Tocar y luchar
description: To Play and To Fight presents the captivating story of the Venezuelan Youth Orchestra System - an incredible network of hundreds of orchestras formed within most of Venezuela's towns and villages. Once a modest program designed to expose rural children to the wonders of music, the system has become one of the most important and beautiful social phenomena in modern history. The documentary portrays the inspirational stories of world class musicians trained by the Venezuelan system, including the Berlin Philharmonic's youngest player Edicson Ruiz and world renowned conductor Gustavo Dudamel. With interviews with many of the world's most celebrated musicians including the great tenor Placido Domingo, Claudio Abbado, Sir Simon Rattle, Guiseppe Sinopoli, and Eduardo Mata, To Play and To Fight is an inspirational story of courage, determination, ambition, and love showing us that... only those who dream can achieve the impossible.

An ordinary housewife takes a stab at making a sexual breakaway through antisocial and free-spirited neighbor. A high-school student falls in love with a call girl. title: Pus$y Catz
description: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future. What begins as hustle turns into a high-stakes war of trust, power, and consequences. As the women push deeper into a high-stakes hustle that promises fast cash, their world quickly becomes a maze of scams gone wrong, toxic relationships, manipulation, and revenge. A shady figure from Lena's past reappears, Toya's choices draw unwanted attention, and Semone's loyalty is tested on all sides. The trio begins to fracture, with each woman caught in the crossfire of decisions they can't take back. The tension reaches a breaking point when a setup turns violent, exposing hidden alliances, buried grudges, and a truth that threatens to destroy their bond forever. In a final confrontation where reputations, relationships, and lives hang in the balance, the women must decide: Will they claw their way out together, or tear each other apart? Pus$y Catz Bratz is a gritty, stylish blend of urban drama, betrayal thriller, and character-driven storytelling-where every choice has a cost, and every secret has claws.

Starving artists who already have a number of films to their names, Czech Lion award-winning films, excellent reviews and have been screened at numerous festivals, but they don't have audiences. description: Rare access within the walls of the notorious Sing Sing Correctional facility to follow the lives of several of society's forgotten men as they experience the transformative power of education while going through a rigorous college program called Hudson Link-- with astounding statistical results.

title: Zero Calling
description: Zero Calling is the story of an ordinary man, David, who is coerced by a mysterious caller, Zero, to do his bidding by 'righting wrongs' in Singaporean society. David quickly realizes what he is doing is no more than gutter vigilantism - taking the law into his own hands. However, David cannot escape from Zero because this mysterious master has made him a slave: Zero knows where he is, what he does and even who he talks to. It seems like Zero also has the power to harm those he holds dear - his wife, Julie, and his teenager step-daughter Maddy, and will not hesitate to do it in the course of playing this twisted game. Through this difficulties, David races with time to find out the identity of Zero so that he can have his life and privacy back. Who is Zero? An enemy from the past? Whoever he is, he has to be unmasked and stopped before he claims another victim - or before the police closes in on David and puts him behind bars.

description: When former United States Navy officer, Steve McGarrett, returns home to Oahu to find his father's killer, the Governor offers him the chance to run his own special task force: Five-0.

title: Ground Zero
description: Global warming and the greenhouse effect are common phrases in today's world, but very few people are aware of the implications and the extent to which global warming affects each of us everyday. Ground Zero will uncover the downfalls of our ecosystem and what we can do to change the atmospheric balance which is evolving daily.

title: Zero Tolerance

title: Zero Absolution
description: Daphne Rhodes is a down-on-her-luck California girl just off the bus in a Midwestern city is starting completely over. She has no friends there and dim prospects until she meets Rex English, a wealthy financier whose suave nature is exceeded only by his persistence. Rex is immediately smitten, relentless in his pursuit and does Daphne a huge favor. But what does he want in return? What looks like it could be a fairy-tale meeting and love story turns sour when the two are caught by his wife, leading to a shocking turn of events. Daphne's already bleak future is put in further jeopardy, but there is the possibility of a huge payoff if she can just work through the unexpected mess. Who can she trust? Her decision leads her right into the pit of an unspeakable and macabre hell. At first, it was about finding the right person and possibly making some money. Ultimately, all that will matter to her is staying alive.
