title: Car God Returns
description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

title: The Teen Queen
description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

title: Mission Admission
description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
description: When a brilliant but humble scientist is falsely accused by a fame-hungry influencer, he must fight a ruthless social media trial, powerful enemies, and public humiliation to reclaim his name and complete a mission that could change India's future.

title: Dil Ka Encounter
description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

title: The Return of the Ultimate Mom
description: Watch this show live on KuKuTV now!

title: Pyar ka Turbulence
description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger [Hindi]
description:
A fearless delivery girl’s good deed spirals into an accidental marriage with a man she believes to be penniless—unaware he’s heir to a billionaire empire.
As family secrets, jealous rivals, and office politics threaten her dreams, she must fight for dignity, ambition, and love.
A tale of hidden identities, chaotic matchmaking, and an unexpected romance that could change her life forever.

title: Codename Pyaar
description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

title: Beghar Billionaire
description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

title: Time Travel [Hindi]
description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Rahul mysteriously travels back in time, determined to change his fate, save his family, and protect Alia from powerful enemies only to discover that altering the past comes with dangerous new consequences. Watch Now!

title: The Richest Bank Robber
description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

title: Social Media ka Billionaire
description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions [Hindi]
description: "Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions" A wealthy young heir sets out to “audition” potential father figures to inherit his fortune. As eccentric candidates compete for the role, hidden motives, heartfelt bonds, and unexpected twists blur the line between family and fortune.

title: Oops, It Was My Husband [Hindi]
description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

title: My Accidental Royal Husband [Hindi]
description: In a twist of fate, a common woman accidentally marries a royal heir, unaware of his true identity. As she navigates palace intrigue and royal duties, their bond deepens, leading her to discover unexpected love and power.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: Just Divorced
description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

title: Brahmrakshas
description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

title: Paralysed Dulha [Hindi]
description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.

title: My Commando Wife
description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

title: The Miracle Surgeon
description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

title: Ruthra Thandavam
description: Ruthra Thandavam

title: Mafia's Innocent Bride [Tamil]
description:
Don David rules the dark underworld of Chennai. His word is law, his eyes spell death.

When Meera is pulled into his ruthless world, she faces blood, betrayal, and revenge at every turn.

The throne of power is up for grabs. The war has just begun. 🔥

Every moment a riddle. Every scene a shock. Witness it Now!

title: Me and My Sister [Tamil]
description: ஒரு போர்ல நல்லா அனுபவப்பட்ட ஒரு சோல்ஜர், ஒரு அழகான, பவர்ஃபுல் CEO-க்கு பர்சனல் பாடி கார்டா மாறறான். மறைஞ்சிருக்கும் ஆபத்துல இருந்து அவளைக் காப்பாத்துறான், அதே நேரம் பெரிய சதித்திட்டங்களையும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். இந்த குழப்பத்துக்கு நடுவுல காதல் மலர, அவனோட பலமும் விசுவாசமும் கொடூரமான எதிரிகள், அப்புறம் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிக்கு எதிரா சோதிக்கப்படுது..அந்த சோதனையில இருந்து தப்பிச்சானா??

title: Battle of Billionaire  [Tamil]
description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

title: Rented Husband [Tamil]
description: Rented Husband

title: My Fiancé Is A Bigshot
description: Divya returns to Chennai hiding her true identity. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by her lover Guru, she is pushed to the edge. A chance encounter with Kishore, a powerful CEO fighting his own battles, changes everything. When Divya’s real strength is revealed, those who mocked her are left helpless. This is the rise of a true Lady Boss.

title: After divorce, my wife become a trillionaire [Tamil]
description: Time Travel and historical movie . After a bitter divorce, a man watches in shock as his ex-wife rises to become a trillionaire overnight. Now, the tables have turned—and so has the game of love, power, and regret.

title: Rocket Tycoon [Telugu]
description: A man learns a woman has last-stage lung cancer and needs treatment within three days. A misunderstanding makes her think he is the patient, leading her to panic over money, insult him, and end the relationship. After a time jump, a young scientist wins a major award, but a powerful businessman and his son disrupt the ceremony, forcing the man to intervene and assert his influence.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Telugu]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: The CEO Son-in-Law
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Mom is not Ugly [Telugu]
description: A self-sacrificing mother confronts her ungrateful son and his disdainful family, with help from the man she once saved, leading to a powerful lesson in humility and redemption.

title: The Prince [Kannada]
description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

title: Love Mocktail
description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Kannada]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: Youngest Secret Billionaire [Kannada]
description: A struggling youngster, dismissed by society, dares to dream beyond limits. Through relentless hustle, bold risks, and defying betrayals, he transforms his failures into steppingstones. Against all odds, he rises from anonymity to shocking the world as the youngest secret billionaire, a tale of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled. Watch now.

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [Hindi]
description: Reborn as nobility with the power to size up talent in a glance, Ars Louvent is on a mission to elevate his new life.

title: PSYЯEN [Hindi]
description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "Psyren." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins-one that will change his fate forever.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

description: Based on a short story by Bengali writer Prafulla Roy, the central idea developed by director Dasgupta, tells the story of a girl, Lati, whose mother Rajani is a prostitute living and working in a brothel in rural India. Rajani plans to offer her daughter to an older man, a rich husband and protector to her daughter. Lati, however, wants to return to school and finish her studies. Unwilling to pay such a price for material success, she runs away to Calcutta. The discovery of this new world is described parallel to other stories of emancipation, such as that of three young prostitutes, of an aged couple going nowhere and man's n landing on the moon. title: A Wave, a WAC and a Marine
description: Henny, talent scout for the Margaret Ames Film Agency in Hollywood, mistakes understudies Judy and Marian for Eileen and Betty, the real stars of a Broadway show and signs them up for movies. Margaret, furious with Henny for the blunder, fires him--temporarily. Another agent, Marty Allen, once married to and still in love with Margaret, signs Betty and Eileen. Henny arrives with Judy and Marian, and the nightclub manager asks Henny to emcee the show. Though he is not sure himself what they can do, Henny introduces the girls and they make a hit in a dramatic sketch. (Simmer down, it's just a Monogram movie, and their nightclub attendees can react anyway director Phil Karlstein/Karlson wants them to.) Big-time movie producer R. J. signs them to a film contract. description: Three years ago, Martha Hale’s husband and son died saving everyone in their building during an earthquake. title: A Gesture and a Word
description: At age 50, musician and poet, Rob Morsberger was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer - and it came at the high point in his career. After 25 years in the music business, critics were starting to compare his songwriting to Randy Newman, Tom Waits and even Stephen Foster. Finally, it was all starting to come together. Rather than succumb to the shockingly grim news that he had 18 to 20 months to live, Rob used it as fuel to launch into the most prolific period of his songwriting career - determined to utilize whatever remained of this physical and spiritual resources to explore through words and music the nature of life, the inevitability of death and the infinite magic in the detail of a single moment. This musical legacy was for all to hear but it was especially for his 8 year old son so he could know and remember his father. "A Gesture and a Word" is a gentle portrait of the greatest songwriter you never heard of - a man who exemplified the phrase, Ars Longa - Vita Brevis (Art is Long - Life is Short).

description: Carlos lives in a youth shelter in the center of Bogota, a kind of refuge trying to mitigate the harshness of life. Its Christmas and Carlos longs to spend the day with his mother and sister, who are lost in the spiral of urban violence. description: Ela e o namorado estavam em um relacionamento à distância há quatro anos. Após o ensino médio, ela foi estudar no exterior e, para que ele não se sentisse inseguro com sua origem modesta, manteve em segredo o status de sua família rica, fingindo vir de uma família comum e alegando que estava estudando fora com empréstimos estudantis. title: Side B
description: Wang Li-Sheng has met a Spanish girl on the Internet and has decided to leave everything behind and live his love story in Spain. Things don't work out the way he expected and he ends up with no girlfriend, no money and no passport.

title: Plan B
description: In order to compete with corporate bars and chain restaurants, a local tavern owner changes his sports bar into a strip bar.

title: B-Horror
description: A horror anthology series consisting of several short films created by Manny Velazquez.

title: 19B
description: in an abandoned villa in a once-refined neighborhood, an old guard has been living since the 1960s. when suddenly, this world is turned upside down by an overzealous young man forcing him to face his fears, his past.

title: B-Happy
description: A determined teenager must rely on her own wits when her fractured family abandons her.

title: R&B Divas
description: Each has had their ups and each have had their downs -- all in the harsh light of stardom. Faith Evans, Nicci Gilbert, Monifah Carter, Syleena Johnson and KeKe Wyatt -- five strong women who have been broken down and are rebuilding from the ground up. R&B Divas takes you inside the lives of these music stars as they work, play and struggle to get their lives and careers back on track. Brought together by their friendship and love of R&B goddess Whitney Houston, these incredible singers are dealing with everything from divorce to drugs and sexuality.

title: Johnny B Good
description: In an effort to impress the girl he loves, a small-time hustler uncovers political corruption.

title: C
description: The Japanese government was rescued from the brink of financial collapse by the Sovereign Wealth Fund.

title: Wife in Apt C
description: When sports photographer Paul is temporarily confined to a wheelchair after a collision on the field with a linebacker, he thinks he will go crazy from boredom - until he catches a glimpse of the wife living in Apartment C across the way. With a parade of men coming in and out of her bedroom, and her shades wide open, Paul has a non-stop sex show right outside his window.

title: C4
description: A man wants to address a woman who is reading a book on how to spot the perfect man.

title: Fangs of Fortune
description: A powerful demon, tired of existence, embarks on a journey of rejuvenation instead of death. Chance encounters bring together a group of youths tracing a bloody path through the world.

title: Sweet Teeth [Hindi]
description: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

title: A, B, C... Manhattan
description: Three women are to make vital decisions about their future. Colleen wants to be a photographer but can't support her daughter Stella. Kacey is looking both for her dog stolen by her ex-boyfriend and for her girlfriend who's dumped her. Kate decided to break up with Stevie and start living on her own.

title: World War C
description: It's war. War against an invisible enemy that is not as deadly as we are told. The world is changing rapidly. Disproportionate measures are taken worldwide that disrupt society as a whole. A dichotomy in society forced vaccinations and restrictions on freedom. Have we had the worst? Or is there something more disturbing to awaiting us.

title: Guess Who I Am [Hindi]
description: Song Yao who never misses a beat in punishing scumbags encounters the fake prince of Chengtian Group. Caught in a Smiths-like battle, the "unremarkable" girl with electrifying eyes and the liar "CEO" begin their story. Legend has it that there's such a person who makes rich scumbags quake in their boots because she never fails to make them suffer the consequences of their actions. This girl's name is Song Yao (Zhang Yuxi). It's all thanks to her fantastic assets in attracting the rich. Any person who is worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her inextricably as long as he looks into her eyes. Yet no matter how powerful she is, there is a day when she will encounter her Waterloo. Song Yao's eyes fail to work on "Ji Chengchuan" who is the prince of Chengtian Group. Little does she know that this is entirely because the prince in front of him is an impostor named Qin Hao (Wang Ziqi). The meeting of the two "actors" is destined to be explosive.

description: She spent a surprise night with the legendary CEO Bingshan, and since then she has become the envy of everyone. He thought he only needed her because she looked like his past lover, but in the end he found out he was completely wrong.

title: Cute Programmer

title: Temps Perdu, Regrets Laissés ( Doublé )
description: Léa Durand est en couple avec Gaston Martin, issu d'une famille riche. Lorsque Gaston a une maladie incurable, Léa est enceinte, et apprend la véritable identité de Gaston. Pour le sauver, elle le quitte délibérément. Elle donne naissance à leur fils Arthur. Cinq ans plus tard, Arthur a un accident de voiture. Léa fait appel à Gaston. La fiancée de Gaston complote pour faire mourir l'enfant, et rejette la faute sur Gaston. Le malentendu entre Gaston et Léa s'aggrave.

title: Le PDG de sang-froid
description: Un petit boulot tourne au face-à-face inattendu avec son ex-mari, PDG impitoyable. Elle tente de fuir, mais il la rattrape : « Tu croyais pouvoir m'échapper ? Jamais ! » S'ensuit une histoire d'amour passionnée entre un patron dominateur et son épouse fragile. Quelles étincelles jailliront de cette rencontre explosive ?

title: When I Fly Towards You
description: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang - her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: From His Surrogate to the Royal Princess
description: Adopted by the Leora family, Omega Eve is betrayed by her sister and her mate. To them, she's nothing more than a surrogate. Then she breaks the mate bond, exposes their scheme, and turns out to be the long-lost princess of the Northern Wolf Pack. When her ex comes crawling back, she shuts him down and chooses the ever-loyal Leonard.

title: The Starry Love
description: Told about a pair of twin sisters with disparate personalities in the royal family of human clans, because a mistake brings about the wrong marriage, not only making countless jokes, but bringing out more of two romantic love.

title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
description: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: My Unicorn Girl
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: The Missing Piece
description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?

title: Enceinte des Triplés du Roi Dragon (Doublé)
description: Vendue par sa famille à des prétendants violents contre de l'eau magique, Amélie, servante renarde que l'on croyait stérile, tombe enceinte de triplés après une nuit avec un inconnu qui est en réalité le Roi Dragon, Édouard. Tandis qu'il la protège de sa famille, de ses rivaux et de collègues jaloux, une attaque destinée à la tuer révèle qu'elle est la princesse perdue du Clan des Loups à Neuf Queues. Les ennemis tombent ; Édouard la fait sienne comme reine.

title: Tininti del barrio
description: The most delightful rip-roaring, comedy of the year.

title: Escalators
description: Entirely set on escalators, the film gives insight into the lives and stories of average people spending a fraction of each day on moving stairs.

title: The Story of Ming Lan
description: An unfavoured child of a rich family, Ming Lan studies and works hard, and falls in love with the son of a high official. Through cunning schemes, they both rise in position and work to obtain justice from those that have wronged them.

title: The Prosecutor
description: A poor young man is wrongly charged with drug trafficking after being deceived. An ex-prosecutor investigates the case, uncovers a corrupt lawyer team's scheme, and restores justice despite obstruction from evil forces.

title: Paranormal Highway
description: There are areas in the United States known for mysterious and unexplained phenomena, creating what are called paranormal hot spots. A team of investigators travels the country to experience and document these strange, unexplained events.

title: Fallen Princess, Rising Empress
description: After her kingdom falls, Princess Claire Rowan survives only to be handed to Regent Victor Bishop as a tool of humiliation. Burning with vengeance for her slain family, Claire uses her wit to navigate the royal court, quietly building her power to save her people. Victor's disdain slowly turns to love as he realizes she's the very woman who once saved his life.

title: Doodle Toons
description: The misadventures of Bellybutton the Rabbit and his various friends.

title: Love at Dangerous Speeds
description: A runaway bride finds refuge with a charismatic street racer. As their deal turns to love, a devastating connection from their past threatens to shatter their newfound happiness and force her to make an impossible choice.

title: Online Boyfriend is My Boss
description: After a year of online dating with her boyfriend who works abroad, Su Xiaoxiao, who is full of expectations, unexpectedly learn that her new big boss Xu Yanshen turn out to be her online boyfriend. Xu Yanshen keeps asking Su Xiaoxiao to meet offline by message, but Su Xiaoxiao decide to hide the truth out of inferiority.

title: You Are My Destiny
description: Two people living on "parallel lines" were never meant to interact, but an unanticipated meeting transforms them into each other's destiny.

title: Four Beast Husbands Vying for Their Curvy Wife
description: Modern doctor Taina transmigrates as a chubby woman who abused her four beast husbands. She cures them, wins the inheritance, awakens the Animal Heart and dragon bloodline, and wins her husbands' hearts, becoming the new leader.

title: My Baby Talks! Her Billionaire Dad
description: My Baby Talks! Her Billionaire Dad

title: The Young Master Strikes Back
description: As the top disciple of a mystic pavilion, Gu Yu keeps his true identity hidden as he sets out to find the benefactor who once saved his life. His search leads him to the Li sisters, and by a twist of fate, he ends up marrying the elder sister, Li Weiwei—only to be met with cold indifference. It is then that he realizes he has made a mistake—the one he has been looking for all along is her younger sister, Li Jiale…

title: Love Legend
description: After surviving a blood jade sacrifice by her family, Yun Shao joins the Fengyi Guards to seek justice and uncover the truth behind strange activity at a blood jade mine. Bound to Pei Zhao by a mysterious Gu, they become caught in a dangerous struggles and court intrigue.

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.

title: Legend of Xianwu [English] S1-S2
description: Banished after failing to protect his sect's medicine field, Ye Chen faces betrayal from peers and his lover. A heavenly flame helps him grow stronger as he fights opponents and forges a new path.

title: Marry the Hidden Billionaire
description: She had a big fight with her treacherous boyfriend over the betrothal gift, so she got married to a stranger. She thought the man she got married to was a poor clerk, but she didn't expect that the man was a billionaire president with a hidden identity. And after the marriage, the president doted on her.

title: The Epoch of Miyu
description: On her 10th wedding anniversary, Miyu Xu realizes her perfect marriage is a facade and files for divorce. She starts anew as a room attendant at the Purong Hotel, where Feng Ji, now the general manager, returns to his roots. As they face professional challenges, their support for each other grows into romance, leading to personal happiness and the transformation of the hotel into a Shanghai landmark.

Honoring his father’s dying wish, Long Taisen quits the boxing world, seals his immense power with iron rings, and lives in obscurity while raising his daughter, Long Chuchu, alone. Twenty years later, the Long Boxing Gym thrives under Chuchu’s leadership, while the once-legendary champion works quietly as a janitor in his own gym. When the Grand Championship is revived and the nation’s only qualification spot is granted to the Long Gym, Long Chuchu insists on competing—once again facing the ruthless underground fighters from Nanyang. title: My Handsome Bodyguard [English]
description: Chu Tao, a former Dragon General turned single father and security guard, navigates secrets of the past while entering a contractual marriage with Lin Wan'er, an ambitious leader seeking vengeance.

title: Dragon Lord's Reborn Contract Bride
description: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. Everyone mocks her, but on their forbidden wedding night, Eileen’s divine blood awakens Kael’s sealed dragon god core. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

title: On the Day of Divorce, The Entire Mafia Came to Fetch Me Home
description: Patricia is the most powerful mafia boss in Sicily, yet she gave up her name for five years to be a housewife. Then her husband Robert betrays her for the boss's daughter, and even her son calls another woman mom. When they smash her gift and tear up the transfer papers, Patricia stops pretending and returns as the woman who rules the underworld.

title: F. P. 1 Doesn't Answer
description: An artificial island in the Atlantic functions as an aerodrome. A sabotage attempt is thwarted by a renowned aviator's intervention, securing the island's safety.

title: Hurricane F.Y.T.
description: -Montreal (in Canada), 1991. Eleven year old Delphis grew up in a poor neighborhood and an unstable family environment. One night he decides to take control of his life and becomes L'Ouragan (Hurricane). Armed with a lightning bolt on his bandanna and his middle finger held high, he leads his life as he sees fit, in a world that has no place for him. His adventure is like a road trip, from the slums to downtown, from one family to another. In the course of his time on the streets and in his attempts to conquer himself, he finds what's most important: his purity.

title: F(l)ag Football

title: F for Friends
description: F For Friends is the story of two unconventional middle age friends who go through life experiences spanning from past to the present. We are searching for distributers and producers to shoot other episodes.

title: Rio, 100 Degrees F.
description: A semi-documentary on the people of Rio de Janeiro. The camera follows boys from a hillside shanty town who sell peanuts at Copacabana, Sugar Loaf Mountain, and a soccer game. Various subplots, involving characters they meet along the way, are interspersed.

title: F... U, OK?
description: Join the comic misadventures of 4 just-out-of-college friends with a kooky business idea. As they embark on an all-night contraceptive delivery service, fresh nuances of modern love and relationships begin to unfold in front of their eyes.

title: Kyûteî Hanî F
description: One night, a man carrying a briefcase is attacked by masked bandits. Cutey Honey narrowly saves him. The man's briefcase, an archaeologist, contains a strange chrysalis that he stole from the Panther Claw organization.

title: You're F@#K'n Dead!
description: Two sisters take a wrong turn and find themselves in a strange, forgotten town not found on any map. When the sisters discover the town's true dark nature, they become targets, fighting for their souls against an evil that will never let them leave.

title: MTV Big F
description: MTV Big F is a finite television episodic series broadcast by MTV India. It premiered on October 11, 2015, every Sunday. The show brings Gautam Gulati as host and set to deal with youngster's forbidden fantasies by showcasing stories of youngsters in each episode. The second season is hosted by Bollywood actor Randeep Hooda which primarily revolves around the psyche of Indian women to explore their hidden desires.

title: F/X
description: A movie special effects man is hired to fake a real-life mob killing for a witness protection plan, but finds his own life in danger.

title: H
description: The struggles of a heroin addict, surviving each hit, perilously close to death, Rhonda hates her life and what it's become. Hope. Help. Heaven. Hell. Healing. Hurting. Heroin.

title: Issho ni H Shiyo
description: Your childhood friend has no place to spend the night. She asks you if she could stay at your place. You obviously agree. She comes a little drunk and upon seeing that you have no girlfriend and fap only to hentai (tissues), she decides to make you a man.

title: I Do, I Don't
description: With a weakening marriage, Shawn and Jess turn to a faith-based retreat to salvage their union. As they seek reconciliation, an unexpected encounter causes Shawn to question his faith, marriage, and belief in God.

title: If I Should Die Before I Wake
description: Brian Edwards has his career, home life and reputation torn asunder as he surrenders to the advances of the teenage Christian Egan. The outcome of their affair nearly costs both of these characters their lives.

title: Zatch Bell! [Hindi]
description: Kiyo Takamine meets a momoto (demons from another world) boy zatch bell and set out to compete in the momoto games held every 1000 years to become their king.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. This is the motto of the Yoo family: the father is a successful doctor, the mother supervises their daughter's scholastic performance from the vantage point of their beautiful home. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

title: Teogonia [Hindi]
description: It's a time of warfare where relentless battles continue between human and demi-human tribes like the Ash Monkeys (Macaque) and pig people (Ogres) invading human lands. Kai, a boy from the village of Rag, spends his days immersed in battle to protect his village. Amidst the harsh battles enforced by those possessing immense power known as "guardian bearers," and as his comrades fall one by one, Kai suddenly recalls memories he shouldn't have experienced-memories of a world with advanced technology and knowledge of people's lives beyond this world. And thus, although Kai was just a villager, he soon finds himself embroiled in great trials... A magnificent fantasy tale unfolds, chronicling the struggle and growth of a single boy in a harsh world.

title: And I Ride and I Ride
description: Musician and Kat Onoma band leader until 2004, Rodolphe Berger lives as if he had nine lives. He's had many determining if paradoxical meetings, with artists or fameless and workless characters, to the point of sabotaging himself sometimes. He kept on going no matter what, transfiguring rock music, mixing his own intimate story with some history of music, a story of people with a story of places. He kept going towards a destination he didn't necessarily want to know about. We only know where his home bases are: Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines, Paris, Batz Island. We only know that it all stems from something - that his personal path took him from philosophy to music.

title: I Wish I Was Like You
description: "I wish I Was Like You" is a documentary about the Nirvana concert that was held in Marino in the Province of Rome on February 22, 1994. But it is also a backwards journey through the '90s, conducted by the two directors, spectators of that era and that memorable event. The Palaghiaccio (Ice Palace) in Marino, where the concert was held, now stands abandoned, dilapidated and sadly destined to become a supermarket. 25 years after Nirvana's last public performances and Kurt Cobain's death, the structure appears as a symbol of decadence but also becomes the point of departure for a celebration of those protagonists and a reflection on that historical period. The general tone is semi-serious, ironic and sacrilegious: the two directors handle the subject of the memory in a light-hearted manner with the aid of personal archival material shot on VHS-C during the many wild nights they spent together when they were kids. The documentary is further enriched by a precious bootleg recording of the Nirvana concert, restored and remastered for the occasion. "I Wish I Was Like You" is a true declaration of love to the filmmakers' youth and its most precious soundtrack: Kurt Cobain and Nirvana.

title: K beregu pyatogo okeana
description: Already twice a mysterious fireball descended into the deep taiga, forming a mysterious zone in the landing area. From distant Petersburg, a young scientist, an enthusiast Kairov, is going to the zone. Hearing that in the zone called "Devil's Ring", full of gold, his random companion Kuzmin, a thief and an adventurer, stole the looted jewelry together from his accomplices, sets off for Kairov. He is not afraid of the local claims that "damn gold" does not bring good to anyone. Nor does it stop that on the heels of ex-friends who are offended in their best feelings by the insidiousness of their comrade and who are ready to deal with him, with his learned companion, and with each other too, just to get hold of jewelry and gold.

title: Gunman in Joseon
description: Based in the time of enlightenment of 19th-century Joseon, This drama tells the story of Joseon's last swordsman named Park Yoon Kang who grabs a gun ditching his sword and grows to become the era's hero. Park Yoon Kang is the son of the best swordsman in Joseon. After his father and sister get killed, he trades sword for gun as he embarks on his revenge mission.

title: Kadhal Pagadai
description: Kadhal Pagadai revolves around middle-class families in Konar Colony, in Chennai, in the late 1990s. The show showcases the struggles revolving in middle-class families and the youngsters love live, through emotional outbursts, with comic reliefs here and there. Though there is no main characters, the story mainly revolves around a family living in Konar Colony. The family is led by Mohanbabu, a clerk in a government office, though his wife Vanja is the one leading the family as the only woman. Mohanbabu younger brother, Rajbabu, is a clerk in a chit fund company. He has a girlfriend named Sithara, who is an orphan. Rajbabu hides this fact from his family, as he want to settle first before marrying Sithara. But Sithara's flashback from her college days involving Ramana, forces Rajbabu to introduce her to his family, and his elder sister, Girija gets an instant dislike for Sithara. Girija comes down to Chennai from Saudi, seeking money from her brothers, to release her husband from jail back in Saudi. At the same time, Rajbabu losses the chitfund money, due to a sinister plan laid by his office peon, Sanjeevi. Ramana comes forward to offer money to help Rajbabu and Sithara but has a condition that Sithara should stay with him in his Cunnor Estate for 10 days. If Sithara stills loves Rajbabu after their mutual stay, Ramana would not trouble them anymore. Having faith in Sithara and desperately in need for money, Rajbabu convinces a reluctant Sithara to go with Ramana. But soon, his faith turns into a possessive behavior and Rajbabu refuses to trust Sithara. Though, this is the main gist of the plot, Kadhal Pagadai also revolves around other families in the Colony. One such family is the ultra rich and arrogant woman who bought the house that she stayed in. A strict old man with 2 daughters, who is the only man in the colony to have a telephone, which irritates him as he has to pass messages to the people in the colony. His elder daughter, Nandhini who loves her neighbour, a mechanic and the duo runs away when her father opposes. A Palakad Brahmin family, who is one of the main comic relief in the show. A disabled helper around the colony, named Ayyappan. A struggling cinema actor, also a fraud, with whom Sithara's friend Sundari was in love with, but breaks up after knowing his fraudulent nature. How all these families overcome their daily challenges? Would Ramana win Sithara's heart? Or would Rajbabu and Sithara unite again? forms the climax.

title: Sju Kammers - Frontsøstrene
description: In Purcells opera Dido and Aenaes, Dido ends her own life with the words "Remember me, but forget my faith." Solace embodies this lament with women silenced by war, united in a choice they made when they were young. Through separate chapters we meet six women who once worked as Red Cross nurses at the Eastern Front. During WWII thousands of European women volunteered to the war zones to serve as nurses for the German Red Cross. In the front lines they cared for wounded German soldiers - and soldiers of other nationalities. These women became known as the Front sisters. On the journey back home after the war had ended they survived through a war-harried Germany. Many returned traumatised and would be socially harassed by their community. In Norway they were imprisoned for treason, condemned for saving the wrong lives. Solace is a film about young women who went out with a desire to help, for later to be associated with some of the most gruesome acts of the twentieth century. At the end of the road they finally dare to reveal some of their innermost painful memories, letting us in to their long-time secrete rooms for the first time.

title: Work Later, Drink Now S1-S2
description: The story of three women whose belief in life is one drink at the end of the day.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

description: To save her father, Alice works for Daniela Brown, a ruthless mafia queen. A desperate deal turns into a storm of secrets, danger and desire, as Alice becomes the only person capable of breaking through Daniela's cold armor.

title: Hippocampus M 21th
description: The word "Hippocampus" was inspired by the hippocampus, a part of the brain located in the temporal lobe, which plays a key role in the learning process and in the formation of new memories about events lived. It is the hippocampus, which connects all the different parts of an experience to form an episodic memory. The letter M is a tribute to "M - The Monster of Dusseldorf" the film by Fritz Lang inspired crimes committed in Germany in the Twenties. The number "21th" references the period in which the film is set, the twenty-first century: the monsters of today. Apartment 37413 Once a week three crazy brothers meet to relive their childhood disorder eating human raw organs and living a sadomasochistic rapport/intercourse... Apartment 28513 The torture of Barbie. A man enjoys torturing and scarring Barbie, but one day he'll decide to do it with real women... Apartment 13396 A painter uses his blood and his muse's faces to prepare the perfect colors for his masterpiece... Apartment 1932301 A woman is looking for a way to becomes excited and she'll discover it touching/with the contact of insects and cockroaches... Apartment 121197 A self-destructive necromancer conserves the mummified corpse of his husband and every night she has sex with it... Apartment 7428M An erotomaniac obsessed by a clown who is in his house blowing up balloons and exploding it.

title: The M Factor: Shredding the Silence on Menopause
description: Menopause is a silent epidemic affecting the health and well-being of millions of women. This film confronts this neglected crisis, challenges societal and medical shortcomings and advocates for a revolutionary approach to women's health.

title: Rocketship X-M

title: Vostok n 20

title: Lance N' Masques

With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

Dubbed the "King of Lyrical Trickiness," Lupe applies his skill for lyrical flow to the movements of kung fu, joining the world's greatest martial arts masters as they teach Lupe their secrets. Lupe also takes the opportunity to explore China's hip hop scene and record his next hit, Air China, a song inspired by his journey and experience.

title: Dust n' Bones
description: Dust 'n Bones brings to light the legal, political, historical and spiritual challenges faced by First Nations leaders and archaeologists as they fight to give disinterred ancestors their proper reverence.

title: Bldg. N
description: A college student, Shiori, visits an abandoned apartment complex in a provincial city, which is famous for its rumors of hauntings, out of curiosity along with Keita and Maho, who also attend the university. However, there are numerous residents there. As Shiori and her friends begin to investigate, they suddenly experience a violent "bizarre rap phenomenon" and a resident jumps to his death right in front of them.

title: Rob N Roll
description: Decadent Murong Hui teams up with violent bandits after a botched robbery. A female detective pursues them as they scheme to steal a bag of money, leading to chaotic events due to betrayals and twists under the "I rob, you rob me" code.

title: King 'n' Me
description: An eccentric millionaire sends a documentary film crew on a search to find the most legendary icon in the history of rock n roll...The King. Is he alive, as many believe? If so, does he want to be found? Is there any credibility to the often ridiculous tales of sightings? What they soon find will not only change their careers, but also their lives.

title: Zone(n)050
description: In Ledeberg - "Police zone 050" - there is a group of young people that met each other at Keizerpark or Centrumplein. Some say they are drug users, dealers, or commit crimes - A one sided story. In zone(n)050 these young people get a voice to tell us their side of the story. About the problems they have had to deal with, about how difficult it can be to grow up and stay on the right path, and about their dreams. Still one sided, but just as true. Zone(n)050 is a documentary about suns, sometimes absent fathers and amazing mothers.

title: Kit ^n^ Kate
description: Two small kitties named Kit and Kate love their toy box. As soon as they hop inside, magic starts to happen. Kids' imagination transforms their room into a blueberry island, racetrack, or medieval castle. Every time, the kitties create a whole new world with amazing discoveries, surprises, and not-so-easy-to-solve dilemmas.

title: Black n White
description: The murder of two politicians of the ruling party creates a lot of chaos in state politics. During the investigation, police get a lead about the biggest drug racket in North East India.

title: Fame N Fishin'
description: Fishing guide Robin Rebman and singer songwriter Earl 'Peanutt' Montgomery take country music stars for fishing, conversation and singalongs along the Tennessee River.

title: B'hike n BASE
description: This adventure is a unique experience, a journey that combines cycling and base Jump which has never been done before. Adventurer and base jumper Francky Malleus who is 27 and from France, will spend a month and a half on his bike carrying only his camping gear and base jumping equipment on his cargo rack to go jump from the cliffs of the Alps.

title: Vice ayaw pabalikin si Bong Bong sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Vhong at Ogie nagkapikunan sa mainit na puksaan
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

title: Kandidata, excited MALOTLOT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
P-Pop rise! Nagdala ng fresh energy sa studio ang 12-member P-Pop group AZTER sa isang hataw at nakaka-LSS na performance ng kanilang kantang “Parang May Mali.”

Positive ang heart, pero dapat mabilis din ang isip dahil sa Miss Q and A, hindi sapat ang confidence at ganda kundi kailangan din ng wit. Nagpakitang-gilas sa talakan sina Tinderella Marie, C-Jay Ubias Tablit, at Serenity Winter.

Para bang na-manifest ni Tinderella ang sariling pagkalotlot dahil nagkatotoo ang sinabi niyang excited siyang “tumalot.” Siya nga ang unang naligwak matapos maunahan ng mga kalaban sa pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round.

Sina Serenity at C-Jay naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang, kung saan muling nasubok ang kanilang husay sa pagsagot sa playtime questions.

Umulan naman ng kilig at hiyawan sa studio sa pagpasok ng bagong duo na may hawak ng bowl of questions. Sina Brent Manalo at Ralph de Leon muna ang escorts for today. Para patunayan na deserve nila ang posisyon, daanin sa joke time ang audition.

Laging handa, ‘yan ang motto ng ating mga scout. Kaya sa pagsabak nila sa Laro Laro Pick, walang puwang ang doubt. Boy Scouts of the Philippines ang players for today's video. Ang swerte, sa kanila ba ay sasaludo?

Na-curious si Vice Ganda nang makita ang mga girl sa hanay ng players na bahagi ng Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Sa jackpot round, si Yel ang umabante para sa chance na maiuwi ang P200,000 POT money. Naibigay kaya ni Yel ang tamang sagot at naiuwi ang malaking POT money?

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig at good vibes ang hatid ng bisitang power couple na sina Jessa Zaragoza at Dingdong Avanzado sa kanilang performance, kasabay ng pagdiriwang nila ng kanilang 25th wedding anniversary. Parang ‘nainggit’ si Kim Chiu?

Akala n’yo tapos na, aba’y may comeback pang naghihintay. Ang tatlong reynang minsang natalo, muling lumaban nang sabay-sabay sa isa na namang round ng Miss Q and A Resbakulawan. Ang mga kinagiliwang kandidata na sina Mentoy Alexa Aang, Nicole Ayala Gokongwei, at Nadimunyo Lustre, muling tumalak para sa pagkakataon na tumatak at maiuwi ang korona.

Mula sa playtime questions, naging mas seryoso ang talakan sa Beklamation round kung saan sina Nadimunyo at Nicole ang nagharapan. Pareho nilang sinagot ang tanong na, “Sa panahon ngayon, sapat na ba ang pagsusumikap para umasenso?”

I-add ang tapang, i-multiply ang galing, tapos i-subtract ang kaba para mag-win. Mga future engineers ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Si Kim Chiu, biglang nahiya. Ay, si Jerald pala ang nakita! Mukhang effective ang lucky charm ni Jerald—kung si Kim man 'yon ang mga paru-paro sa buhok niya, dahil matapos ang pagsusulit, siya ang naging “topnotcher” ng batch at nakakuha ng slot sa jackpot round.

Para sa kanyang maraming pangangailangan sa eskwela at sa mga pangarap ng kanyang ama at ina, sinugalan ng University of the Philippines student ang ₱300,000 POT question at tinanggihan ang ₱40,000 Li-Pot offer. Hindi man niya nakuha ang tamang sagot, may magandang blessing na naghihintay kay Jerald dahil nangako si Vice Ganda na tutulungan siyang makabili ng bagong laptop para sa kanyang pag-aaral.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: Miss Q&A: Barbie Bratz
description:
Kung may sariling opinyon, 'yan ay karapatan! Basta't may respeto pa rin, huwag matatakot ipahayag ang paninindigan. Nagbabalik ang limang Miss Q and A 'ResBAKS' na sa talakan ay walang inuurungan, sa weekly finals ng Resbakulawan round.

Pare-parehong 'nalotlot' sa unang sabak sa pagtalak, but now they're back stronger and fiercer, still with a dash of laughter. From the daily Resbakulawan, oras na para sa final face-off nina Barbie Bratz Ayuda, Andrea Jane Peralta, Misis Jawo, Miss Mia, at Carla Flores Argonza sa “It’s Showtime” July 25 episode.

Hindi maiwasan ang lutang moments sa unang round. May nabibingi sa tanong, at merong hula-hula lang ang sagot. Si Andrea ang unang naligwak sa laban. Pero bumawi ang candidates sa Wit Lang round.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, sina Barbie Bratz at Carla ang umangat at nagharap sa Beklamation, kung saan pareho silang palaban sa katanungan na, "Ano ang mas gusto mo, maging pride o joy ka ng magulang mo?" Naghatid nga ng pride at joy sa kanyang mga magulang si Carla dahil siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Resbakulawan weekly winner.

Ika'y mapapangiti sa ganda ni Bianca Umali, na guest co-host nina Vice Ganda at Amy Perez sa Laro Laro Pick, July 25 episode ng “It’s Showtime,” kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Don Bosco, Paranaque.

Si Joan ay tumama kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round for the chance to win P100,000. Matapang na sinugalan ni Joan ang POT question, ngunit bigo siyang maibigay ang tamang sagot.

Sa dulo ng programa, naglabas ng isang statement si Vice Ganda. Aniya, nakarating sa pamunuan ng "It's Showttime" ang mga komento ng viewers at netizens na na-offend o hindi nagustuhan ang ilang jokes ng hosts, partikular na sa 'Memerimar' episodes sa Laro Laro Pick kaya naman humingi ng dispensa si Vice.

title: Sassa Gurl napadaan sa Miss Q and A
description:
Tayo'y always napapalingon sa kanyang mapulang blush, ang awrahan ni Sasa Gurl for today's video, deserve ng sash. Best in Costume 'yan? Ang Halloween, parang dumating in advance.

Humagupit na sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang bumabagyong kagandahan at wit ng mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A."

Kung costume party ito, effortless si Miss Q&A Kulot ng Cavite, ang 'bunot' ni Vice Ganda for today. Pinag-sample ng gymnastics at pinakanta, pero ang hindi niya naipakita ay 'yung talent na kumagat ng bakal. Isa pang talent niya ay pasayahin ang Madlang People sa charisma niyang kamahal-mahal.

Umuwi man siyang 'lotlot' sa kompetisyon, nasungkit naman niya ang puso ng buong nation. Samantala, sina Chloe Castillo ng Isabela at Rhed Sicuan ng Las Pinas ang umabante sa Wit Lang round kung saan tuluyan nilang pinakawalan ang fierce na skill sa talakan.

Para kina hurado Max Collins, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves, mas matimbang ang bilang ng sagot ni Rhed. Siya ang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Susuyuin ng mga taga-Manuyo Dos, Las Pinas ang swerte upang masungkit nila ang Laro Laro Pick POT money sa “It’s Showtime” July 9 episode.

Enjoy ang hosts sa chikahan with Tin, na pangarap maging pulis noong kabataan pero ngayon makeup na ang kanyang fantasy. Kakaiba naman ang nickname ni Meow, ang solo parent na raketera queen.

Samantala, now showing ang Episode 4 ng Memerimar sa act-song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round. Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro) nagselos dahil para bang mas mahal ni Memerimar (Vice Ganda) si Fulgoso (Lassy). Dumating naman sina Senyora Angelika (Jhong Hilario) at Inocencia (MC) upang makipagsundo kay Memerimar. Pero ang batian, nauwi sa bugbugan!

Sa jackpot round, mabilisan ang naging tawaran nang tanggapin agad ni Lenlen ang Li-Pot offer na P30,000. Malaking tulong na kasi ito pra sa therapy ng anak niyang nasa autism spectrum.

title: Miss Q&A Mentoy ibinahagi ang 'traumatic' experience
description:
Stay safe and stay dry, Madlang People! Kung malakas man ang buhos ng ulan, stay home muna as much as possible. "It's Showtime" and chill muna sabay sayaw ng moves na nakaka-"Oooh Lala!" Kaninong pambato ang panalo sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance for today's video?

With full energy para ang banter ay mas havey, Vice Ganda hosted the Miss Q and A segment with Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro. Kung na-miss n'yo ang bardagulan at puksaan ng trio, heto na, walang kulang!

Sa haba man ng kuwentuhan with candidates Divine Geralde, Vavaing Vurdado, at Mentoy Alexa Ang, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy.

Struggle is real ang ma ‘accla’ sa tawag sa baby Elephant, at pati sa lugar sa Bulacan kung saan sumasayaw ang mga babaeng humihiling na magka-anak. At ang iconic quote ni Julius Caesar, nabago na pala?!

Hirit ni Meme Vice, "Ang sakit sa bangs!" Pero bumawi naman sa Wit Lang round ang dalawang kandidatang pasok sa chukchakan, sina Mentoy at Vavaing Vurdado. Parang bumaliktad ang mga pangyayari, dahil ang performance ni Mentoy, bawing-bawi! Satisfied at masaya si Meme!Sa dulo, wagi si Mentoy bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Kasintapang ng kape ang fighting spirit ng mga baristang sumalang sa game arena kung saan sanib pwersa sina Vice Ganda at Karylle with Tyang Amy Perez.

Parang kape na ayaw mong tigilan, 'amats' naman ni Vice Ganda ang intern ng programa na biglang napasali pa sa aktingan. Samantala, para bang hindi basta aktingan lang ang hugot ni Ryan Bang kay Kim Chiu sa isang eksena. Hopia ba talaga?!

Saktong timpla ng swerte at diskarte ang mayroon si Ver, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante. Sumugal si Ver sa POT question, na may kinalaman tungkol sa kapeng barako.
