title: Emma Tiglao umupo bilang Miss Q and A hurado
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Nabigo sa Ral nagbabalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A: Ano ang English ng tanikala?
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

title: Kandidata, may matinding pinagdadaanan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Bumisita ngayong maulan na Wednesday ang bandang Hilera, na ibinandera ang OPM punk rock genre sa kanta nilang "Diretso." Ipinakilala rin ng banda ang bago nilang miyembro.

Kumpleto muli ang energetic trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario, na sinimulan ng Miss Q and A sa puksaan ng OOTD... at odor?!

Tuloy-tuloy naman ang puksaan sa rampahan as the Miss Q and A candidates walked the runway in their pakak-tail dresses. Nagpakilala sina Stacey Doroteo, Jillian Indefonso, at Queen Mortel. At bago ang paunahan sa pagsagot ng trivia questions sa Tumapk Ganern round, kinilatis muna ang ladies sa kanilang talent at energy.

Kung si Stacey ay pinagkakakitaan ang husay sa pagsasalita bilang host, hirit ni Meme, 'yung iba pinagkakakitaan ang bibig sa maling paraan katulad ng pagkakalat ng chismis at fake news. No, no 'yan! Heto ang hindi fake news, si Queen Mortel, may pinagdadaanan. Kaya naman ang hosts, sumuko na lang matapos mag-fail na ilabas ang highest energy ni Queen.

Epic fail in the funniest way naman ang sagot ng mga 'accla' sa mga tanong sa unang round, katulad ng tanong na may kinalaman sa matamis na syrup sa taho, Filipino term para sa petal, at pangalan ni Mars Ravelo.

Sa hinaba-haba man ng hulaan, sa Wit Lang pa rin ang tuloy nina Stacey at Queen Mortel. Ang nabunot na tanong ni Stacey, "Anong mas mahirap i-maintain, relasyon o bank bank balance?" Tumapat naman kay Queen Mortel ang tanong na, "Alin ang mas nakakagising ng group chat, 'yung bagong tsismis o 'yung may nag-leave sa group?"

Kung suspended ang klase, ’wag munang malungkot. Ang mga college students from Pasay, sa "It's Showtime" muna pumasok. At ang activity nila, mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakipagkuwentuhan sina Vice Ganda, Karylle, at Ogie Alcasid sa mga bisitang etsudyante. As they get to know the students, mas napansin ni Vice na para bang nawawala na ang sense of curiosity ng mga kabataan, kaya pinaalalahanan niya ang mga estudyante na maging curious sa paligid at palawakin ang kaalaman.

Samantala, kung bibigyan ni teacher ng grade ang mga eksena sa You Gotta Lyric, siguradong lahat ay makakamartsa sa entablado dahil sa aktingan na pasado. Si Jackie Gonzaga, biglang

nag-transform in the middle of her scene with Cianne Dominguez, kaya hirit ni Meme Vice, "I love the plot twist!"

Heto ang plot twist in life na hinihintay ni Zie, ang Business Administration student na umabante sa jackpot round. Sinugalan ni Zie ang P250,000 POT question ngunit bigo itong maibigay ang tamang sagot sa tanong na, "Anong instrumento ang ginagamit sa pagsukat ng bilis ng hangin?"

Hindi pa rin siya uuwing luhaan dahil sa P5,000 ayuda mula kay Vice Ganda.

title: WALANG WINNER TODAY sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

Dahil brand new ang week, may fresh batch of "Miss Q and A" candidates na nag-hello sa "It's Showtime."Ganap na ganap sa puksaan at talakan sina Binibining Dana, Jinger Aman Villamor, at Wynzhl Bansagan.

Pagkatapos ng Tumpak Ganern round, sina Jinger at Binibining Dana ang nakalusot, samantalang si Wynzhl ay umuwing lotlot" Anong mas ayaw mo kapag matutulog, ‘yung may maingay na aso o may katabi na amoy aso?" ang tanong na nabunot ni Jinger. Sakto because she's a loving fur mom! Pero mukhang hindi sumakto ang sagot niya kina hurados Bianca Umali, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves. Gano'n din ang komento nila sa sagot ni Binibining Dana, na tumalak tungkol sa mga bestie na snaky.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, parang walang winner today. Pero maya-maya pa ay kinoronahan ang totoong reyna. Sa araw na 'to, si Jinger ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Samantala, ginamit din ni Brent Manalo ang boses para 'tumalak' sa ipapatayong AI and semiconductor industrial hub, Pax Silica, sa kanyang hometown sa Tarlac. At sa pagbabalik ni Darren, naipit si Jackie Gonzaga, na sa sobrang haba ng hair ay balik-love triangle with Darren at Brent.

Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, nagpahinga muna ang mga players na masahista. Minalas no'ng una pero bumawi ang swerte kay player Budang, na nabunot para sa jackpot round. No'ng una ay ipinaglaban niya ang POT para sa inang may cancer, at kapatid na may sakit sa puso. Pero, minsan panalo na rin ang sigurado, kaya sa dulo, forda Li-Pot na si Budang sa halagang P30,000. Sinunod niya si nanay.

title: GALIT AKO! Miss Q&A Bb. Talinghaga kumasa sa aktingan
description:
Very timely ang rakrakan na hatid ng tatlong fan-favorites sa latest season ng Tawag Ng Taghalan—sina Kisen Abrogar, Will De Sosa, at Jeanel Silvestre, na pinukaw agad hindi lamang ang energy, kundi ang 'feels' ng Madlang People.

Pakak kung pakak ang lineup ng candidates sa June 29 episode ng "It's Showtime." Mukhang nasala nang mabuti ang batch na 'to, kaya walang tapon sa tatlo! Kung talakan ang usapan, palaban sina June Pangilinan, Khaye Corpuz, at Bb. Talinghaga.

Si June na fluent sa English, very smart ang atake as she talked about her museum adventures. Kung fluent si June sa English, matatas naman sa wikang Filipino si Bb. Talinghaga. At kahit tahimik sa umpisa, huwag 'anchahin' si Candidate #2, Khaye, dahil siya naman ay matatas sa swardspeak o gay lingo.

Dahil brainy ang mga kandidata for today's video, swabe lang ang tanungan sa Tumpak Ganern round. At hindi sila takot bumoses kahit pa maglabas ng galit sa gobyerno.

Nagtuloy-tuloy ang nakabibilib na 'chukchakan' sa Wit Lang, kung saan sina June at Bb. Talinghaga ang nagpuksaan. Kung gaano ka-witty ang 'say' ng mga kandidata sa entablado, gano'n din ang komento ng mga hurado, na sina Vince Maristela, Karylle at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao.

June is the month of weddings, sabi nga nila. Kaya naman mga bagog kasal na ginang ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pang-teleserye ang love story ni Nanay Lina, na sa edad na 67 ay ikinasal kay Virgilio, na itinuturing siyang first love. Patunayy lang sila na kahit anong edad, lumipas man ang panahon, basta iginuhit ng tadhana, magtatagpo ang dalawang puso. Teka, bakit mukhang affected si Kim Chiu?

Parang pelikula rin ang kwento ni Ayhie, na finally ay ikinasal na matapos ma-diagnose sa sakit na cancer. Habang patuloy siyang lumalaban sa sakit, hindi nagkukulang sa pagmamahal at pasensya si mister, na itinuturing din niyang best friend.

Mukhang kay Ayhie talaga ang araw na 'to! Dahil naibahagi na niya ang kanyang kuwento bago maglaro, siya pa ang nabunot para sa jackpot round. Kung anong desisyon ni misis, aprub kay mister. Kaya si Ayhie ang nasunod at tinanggap niya ang Li-Pot offer.

title: OGs plus Gen Zs! Vice, Anne, Darren, Brent nagkulitan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Ang mga divas ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan, pagdating sa kantahan, siguradong palaban at walang inuurungan. Intense na birit ang bitbit nina Carmelle Ccollado, Lyka Estrella, Arvery Lagoring, at Marielle Montellano na sanib-pwersa sa pagkanta ng "Gusto Ko Nang Bumitaw."

In real life, may gusto rin ba silang bitawan? Heto pa ang hindi mo gugustuhing palampasin. Si Jillian Ward, kumasa sa 'Meme' dance challenge. Si Ogie Alcasid, hindi mapigilang mag-reminisce. Parang kailan lang, si Jillian ay little girl na makulit pero ngayon isa nang binibining marikit.

Sina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, Brent Manalo, at Darren Espanto nag-collab sa pag-host ng Miss Q and A segment para sa September 4 episode. Si Brent, hindi mapakali dahil katabi niya ang crush na "Dyosa." Hanggang sa nauwi ang kulitan sapersonalan?!

Tatlong kandidata ang rumampa para subukan ang kanilang wit sa Miss Q and A. Meet Jessy Fami, Maria Princess Joy Rosario, at Hera Sanchez Santivañez. Sina Hera at Maria ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, kung saan hinarap nila ang questions na may kasamang playtime geography lessons? Kay Hera, “Kung kalbo ka, titira ka pa ba sa Laguna?” habang kay Maria naman tumapat ang tanong na, “Pwede bang maglakad ang mga bakla sa Baclaran?”

Kapag swerte ang kumatok, dapat agad pagbuksan. Dahil baka ito na ang araw na papabor sa'yo ang kapalaran. Lahat ng hamon ay kakayanin because they can! Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, bumida ang mga taga-Bocaue, Bulacan.

Ang dating line cook na si Kurt ang naka-survive sa lahat ng challenges at umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P200,000 POT question. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer pero sayang nga naman ang pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q&A Lucky, may love advice sa co-candidate na NBSB
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?

title: MC at Lassy nagtrain kay Miss Q&A Mikkay
description:
Siguradong mapapangiti ka sa kilig dahil not just one, but four Gen Zs ang bumisita sa "It's Showtime" today. Sina "PBB Collab 2.0" heartthrobs Heath Jornales, Marco Masa, at John Clifford, at Big Winner Caprice Cayetano, kumasa sa "Ooh Lala Baby! Cuties!

On fire ang mga Miss Q and A candidates as they faced the toughest and most mind-boggling questions. Sina Jers Sabado, AC Faulkerson, at Mikkay Clemente ang nagharap-harap sa 'chukchakan' at puksaan ng talent. 'Yun nga lang, si Mikkay, talent daw ang "magmahal nang paulit-ulit kahit nasasaktan."

Mabilis ang naging sautan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa natira sina Mikkay at Jers para magharap sa Wit Lang kung saan may kinalaman sa mga fairytale characters ang tanong.

"Bakit naka-cropped top si Winnie the Pooh? Gen Z ba siya?" Sagot ni Mikkay, kailangan talagang mag-adapt sa changing times. Ang nabunot naman ni Jers, "Papayag ka bang ikaw si Rapunzel pero buhok sa ilong ang mahaba sayo?" Ang sagot niya, oo, dahil hindi siya makikinig sa mga panghuhusga sa kanyang pisikal na itsura.

Swerte ay tumama sa isang lucky player na naghatid ng saya at game na humarap sa challenges sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, featuring Madlang Players na mga taga-Taguig.

Sanay pumito si player Mike pero break muna siya sa trabaho bilang referee. Si Botchok naman, parang walang break ang pagkukuwento, naidagdag pa nga niya ang tips on how to spot a plastic na kamag-anak.

Walang plastikan, sobrang saya ng aktingan sa You Gotta Lyric round! Si Amy Perez, may pamana kina MC at Lassy! Si Jugs Jugueta naman ay ginulo ng anghel at demonyo, na itago na lang natin saa pangalang Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Bago sumalang sa laro, panalangin ni Kevs ay ibigay sa kanya ang swerte kung ito ay meant to be! At sa kanya nga iginuhit ni destiny ang pagiging lucky! Para sa kanyang pinakamamahal na lola, naging praktikal si Kevs at tinanggap ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: After We're Over
description: One fateful Saturday, Zelzah (Adrienne Rose White) receives a call out of the blue from her ex, Sazerac (Chris Mollica). It's the first she's heard from him in the year since he broke her heart and left St. Louis to move home to Long Island. Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. Over the course of the day, the film slips in time. As the two come together in the present, we see them fall apart in the past, their memories bleeding into their current conversations. While visiting some of the city's most famous landmarks, they discuss love, death, sex, politics, memory, and what we owe to each other and ourselves, as well as the ultimate question: can they begin again after they're over?

title: You're Fired
description: Railroad magnate Gordon Rogers agrees to allow his daughter, Helen, to marry wealthy idler Billy Deering, Jr., but only if the latter can hold the same job for one month. Billy is hired for an array of jobs, including office clerk and xylophone player, but always quits just before being fired. He then finds work in a restaurant where he is required to dress as a knight in armor and pose as a statue. On one occasion, Gordon, Helen, and Billy's romantic rival, Tom, enter the restaurant, and Billy is nearly fired when Helen recognizes him. Meanwhile, Gordon plans to merge one of his railroads with a company that is in a dispute with Tom's uncle, an unprincipled financier. Acting on the promise of a generous cash reward, Tom is determined to steal documents relating to the merger. Billy manages to stay at his job for thirty days, and in the process, exposes Tom's scheme, winning Gordon's consent to marry Helen.

title: Honest Man: The Life of R. Budd Dwyer
description: Honest Man: the Life of R. Budd Dwyer is a movie about politics and corruption, suicide and survival. Four years in the making, it explores the scandal that led an honest, hard-working man to take his own life. This independently produced feature-length documentary follows Budd Dwyer, a Pennsylvania politician who infamously committed suicide at a televised press conference. The film chronicles Dwyer's meteoric rise to political power and examines the bribery scandal and subsequent trial that pushed him to his breaking point. Honest Man also delves into the controversy and consequences of the uncensored airing of Dwyer's death on television stations worldwide. Honest Man reveals a story that has remained untold for over 24 years. The film features exclusive new interviews, including William Smith, the man whose testimony convicted Dwyer, and Dwyer's widow Joanne--her last interview before her death in 2009. Was Dwyer venal, or a victim? Did he kill himself because he couldn't live with being guilty, or because he couldn't live with being innocent? Honest Man allows audiences to judge for themselves.

title: Dívka s muslí
description: Thirteen-year-old Vendula (Dita Kaplanová) dozes off at school and dreams about her parents riding in a carriage dressed in their wedding clothes. The young teacher is angry with the girl who has already failed a year, and has no idea that she is looking after three younger half-brothers. They all have a different father and their mother (Evelyna Steimarová) comes home noisy and drunk every day, often accompanied by a man. Early in the morning, Vendula helps her mother clean offices, and sometimes has to do the cleaning all by herself. Her eldest brother Libor is good at school and blindly adores his mother. Jeník is a talented flute player and much more cynical. The youngest Venousek is still a toddler. The only one who is cared of is Vendula by her father (Ladislav Frej), who has divorced his confirmed alcoholic wife years ago and has another daughter in his new family. title: S Is for Sexy
description: Seven Sexy and Smart Short Gay Films: Serene Hunter (France) Set in Paris, the 'hunter' of the title is a 30-something gay male who has a string of one-night stands. Content being free and unfettered by relationships, he happily moves from encounter to encounter. He then surprises himself by becoming involved in a more substantial relationship...but can the hunter within him be tamed? An honest portrayal, with some explicit action. Solace (US) This film shows an older and younger man who meet on the internet, and seem to get along well, until the older man tells about his boyfriend and it shatters younger man's dreams. Scarred (UK) An early 20s male has a significant scar on his face from a knife wound - and is fed up of the unwanted attention that it attracts. Will he find someone who can see past the scar? The answer may lie with an older, middle-aged architect, who seems to be the one person to whom the scar is invisible. Signage (US) Middle age can be hidden somewhat with makeup and hair coloring, which encourages two best friends to plan a night out at a bar that caters to young men half their age. One makes a strong connection with a young deaf guy, only to find out that there is more than one type of obstacle involved. Mr_Right_22 (Germany) First-date jitters in the age of internet dating but a kind waiter calms his fears and offers some encouragement to be open to life's opportunities. Cute. 41 Seconds (Germany) Two masculine friends take about "41 Seconds" to compare notes on one of their dates, in which his girlfriend compared their respective skills as a kisser. Only 4 minutes, but cute. Shahram and Abbas (Netherlands) Two Iranian refugees, a young student activist and an older journalist, who want to see political asylum in the Netherlands. Believing they have a better chance of being granted such if they claim to be a persecuted homosexual couple, they begin a charade that leads to complications they never imagined, especially when the younger Shahram falls for a woman also awaiting asylum. Powerful and positive depiction of a very sad and serious situation.

title: Mister T.
description: Anything is possible in Warsaw rising from the war rubble in 1953. The omnipresent uncertainty, denunciations, and the sense of constant surveillance are tamed with the help of vodka and good company. A renowned writer, Mister T. lives in a hotel for authors and makes a living by giving extra lessons. One day, a young countryside man moves into the next-door flat with big dreams of working as a journalist. Mister T. becomes his mentor and teacher. The pace of the protagonist's life quickens once the authorities begin to suspect him of an evil wish to blow up the Palace of Culture and Science, and Secret Police agents start to watch every move he makes. It is hard to stay serious in this ridiculous reality.

title: Free Money
description: When universal basic income (UBI) comes to the Kenyan village of Kogutu, lives are forever changed. GiveDirectly, one of the fastest growing nonprofits of the 21st century, is sending free money for twelve years as part of the world's largest UBI experiment. Filmmakers Lauren DeFilippo and Sam Soko juxtapose the story of these young economists, bankrolled by Silicon Valley and convinced that they have found an infallible algorithm to end world poverty, with portraits of local Kenyans whose lives are being dramatically impacted for better and for worse. UBI is at the forefront of political debate like never before, thanks to Andrew Yang's presidential candidacy, covid stimulus packages, and trials underway around the world. This documentary is a fascinating case study of life in a village-turned-petri-dish from the perspective of those living out this revolutionary idea.

title: Voltes V [English]
description: A demonic race from a planet fourteen thousand light years away called Boazan headed by Prince Heinel arrived on Earth to start an invasion to fulfill their emperor's ambition of universal conquest. Standing on their way is a group of heroic warriors piloting a a giant ultra-magnetic robot called Voltes V. It was a long and bitter struggle that took the heroes from Earth to Boazan.

title: A.W.O.L
description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

title: W domu
description: Spring 2020, Poland. 16 filmmakers create 14 short films about unexpected experience of isolation caused by pandemic.

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: W klatce
description: Fire changes the life of a dull lonely bank cashier into a hero. He gets the woman he has always dreamt of. But, considering his modesty and peculiarity, will they really be happy together?

title: Remiza. Zawsze w akcji!
description: "The Fire Station" is a warm and cheerful story, full of emotions and dramas, about a group of firefighters from the small village of Brzeziny. It is also a story about rural traditions, the strength of a small community, heroism, joy and bond building. It is not only about tense firefighting actions, but also about making mistakes, about love and the pursuit of happiness. Each episode of the series tells a separate story related to the numerous tasks of the fire brigade: extinguishing fires, removing the effects of natural disasters and the leakage of toxic substances, or assisting the police in searching for missing persons. Sometimes these situations are extremely dramatic, but they can also be humorous and funny. They are all connected by a team of firefighters, whose commander is Robert Orzechowski, a young widower, with his little daughter Karolina. His quiet life, based on work, care for his loved ones and a relationship with the firewoman Magda Wieczorek, is disturbed by the sudden appearance of high school love, Ewa. Ewa, Magda's sister, returns to her native village after twelve years. An old feeling comes to life, but is it possible to go back to what was before without hurting others?

title: Krafftówna w Krainie Czarów
description: A film, creative portrait of an outstanding theater and film actress, which takes the viewer to a world that does not exist anymore, because, as Barbara Krafftówna says in the film, "The huge world in which I lived is already on the other side of the mirror ..." Barbara Krafftówna becomes an ageless character in the film, or like a little Alice from a fairy tale, she crosses the border of realism. For years, it was the key to her acting. The film received a universal message: "Sky is the limit". Imagination has always been an escape from hopelessness for Krafftówna, because her biography, full of professional successes, was not without tragedy. Her life entered the difficult Polish history - Volhynia, the war, Stalinist times, communism, the fight for freedom. Imagination, as she put it herself, was "an escape from the void." The main narrative of the film consists of the protagonist's internal monologues, the archival ones collected over the years by the narrator and screenwriter of the film, Remigiusz Grzela, and those recorded today. These monologues refer to the most outstanding film role of Krafftówna in the film by Wojciech Jerzy Has, "How to Be Loved".

title: Herbert. Barbarzynca w ogrodzie
description: Polish author Zbigniew Herbert is one of the most remarkable poets of the 20th century. His works have been translated into 40 languages, acclaimed and awarded around the world, mainly because of its timeless and universal dimension. In Poland, his significance is even greater, as Herbert was a moral guide in his native country. His poetry was of great importance during the fight against communism. Many Poles learned his poems by heart and remember them up to this day. However, behind the crystalline beauty of his poetry, there is a man struggling with everyday life. His story told by his wife, Katarzyna, and people who were close to him unveils a picture of a unique, yet complex artist. A model of intelligence, humor and charm, on the one hand, Herbert has been struggling with anger, physical pain and mental illness, on the other.

title: Desire Under the Palms
description: As a sideline, a bored suburban wife writes articles for women's magazines. When a friend shows her an explicit men's magazine, she attempts to write erotic material. However, she finds that a lot more first-hand research is required, and her husband is more interested in checkers.

title: Gamer Girl (Flipping the Score)
description: When it comes to video games Sparrow Finch is a savant. From her father's original Atari console to Virtual Reality headsets, Sparrow has always had a natural intuition for video games. One day while at an arcade called the Hive, a boy named Norman allows Sparrow to play the last player of his 'Myths and Mystics' video game. Within no time, Sparrow has completed the entire game. Something that should have taken months. Upon seeing what Sparrow has done, Norman rips the game controller from Sparrow's hands and takes credit for the unheard of accomplishment. Norman is bolstered by Hive's owner Mr. Lastrik and employee, Darryl, both of whom don't believe Sparrow, being a young girl, could accomplish such a feat. Sparrow's stolen accomplishment skyrockets Norman to video game fame and wins him enough prize money to build his own Virtual Reality Arcade, The Commune, while Sparrow is left deeply scarred, in silent unanimity. This year at Denver Comic Convention, Sparrow can finally redeem herself playing in a Myths and Mystics Virtual Reality Video Game Tournament against Norman. Sponsored by the Hive, Sparrow and her team have the opportunity to advance to Nationals in Las Vegas, where Sparrow can reveal her talent on a National stage. But a tear in the universe caused by the 'Virtual Reality Experience' transforms her into her character in the game, a powder blue super soldier and drops her in a world uncannily close to the Myths and Mystics video game. Here, Norman controls a 12 foot tyrant named Conscription who uses a spell called 'Will of Man' to control the viral males of this Universe. Potite Monarch, Sparrow's best friend and love interest is from this Alternate Universe and visits our world by way of her own Virtual Reality video game. Potite is hoping Sparrow's amazing video game skills will translate to superhuman abilities so to defend her planet Verdurous, from Norman and the evil Conscription. Potite employs her brother Maurice to guide Sparrow on her heroine's journey to defeat Conscription, get back to the Tournament and victoriously claim her Grand Champion Status and victory over her detractors.

title: Produce X 101
description: Part of Mnet's talent competition franchise Produce 101. The public "produces" a boy band by choosing 11 members among the 101 trainees from 47 different entertainment companies and independent trainees through online and live voting with multiple elimination rounds. The public also choose the group's concept, name, and debut song.

title: X OVA: Episode 0
description: An OVA showing future events in the series.

title: X500
description: Thousands of kilometers apart, three young migrants undergo mental, emotional, and physical transformations in order to survive the violence of their new worlds.

title: X Repo
description: X Repo

title: X² - Double X
description: A series of music videos to promote the anime 'X'.

title: X Trillion
description: 14 Women. 3000 Nautical Miles. X Trillion Pieces of Plastic. Adventure, discovery, science and solidarity.

title: April X
description: A high octane, near future thriller about twins Bax and April. When April goes missing, Bax searches every dark corner of the post Soviet cityscape trying to find her, ultimately descending into madness.

title: The X Files
description: Two F.B.I. Agents, Fox Mulder the believer and Dana Scully the skeptic, investigate the strange and unexplained, while hidden forces work to impede their efforts.

title: Y
description: Olga's carefree life and family dynamics slowly starts shifting after her grandmother, a very wealthy lawyer, makes an unexpected confession on her deathbed.

title: Y
description: A Balkan war veteran - who is now a homeless alcoholic - dreams that he is a tree growing inside the ruins of his house, which was destroyed in a bombing raid.

title: Escalpelos y justicia
description: Genio médico a los 10 años, traicionada y asesinada. ¡Regresa con un CEO misterioso! Plagios, robos quirúrgicos... ¡Nada la detiene! Expone el fraude de cristales cerebrales en 3 días. Su padre llora; ella ríe: 'Nadie escapará.

title: Alegrijes y rebujos
description: A group of children discover the secret behind a haunted mansion.

title: Calor... y celos
description: Carlos prepares a trip a Cuba with his lover. His plans are spoiled when his wife makes up her mind to go to Havana with him.

title: Palos y risas
description: In a town of violence and crime, a policeman works sternly. But with his cheerful, outgoing personality, he becomes the clown TRAMPOLIN.

title: Barridos y regados
description: Two men bring a message to a manager in an office with two beautiful secretaries. The manager thinks they are the specialists he is waiting for. They see the opportunity to make Money and to conquest the women. So they go through different challenges untill the real specialists arrive.

title: Sueños y caramelos
description: Sofia's grandfather is the head security guard at a huge department store, "El Gran Almacen". At night, while her grandfather guards the store, Sofia uses her imagination to turn the department store into a world of fantasy and dreams. She decides to tell her friends about this new world, and she and her friends have many adventures there. She meets a new boy, Juan, whom she believes is a poor orphan--but in fact he's the son of Mauricio, the department store's owner, and his biggest fear is that he'll lose her friendship forever if and when she discovers his true identity.

title: X/Y
description: A look at the lives and interactions of a group of friends living in New York.

title: ¿Y los tamales?
description: A Honduran cabbie is entrusted with picking up a payload of tamales for Christmas Eve. On his journey, he picks up some spicy characters that all have their secrets to hide. Together, they take a long taxi ride into comical redemption.

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. Through interviews and an array of musical settings the film explores the young people's feelings in a humorist yet serious manner, bringing to the forefront issues of biases and national identity inherent in this innocent yet very powerful form of social entertainment. Includes musical performances by Gilberto Santa Rosa, El Gran Combo, REO Speedwagon and others.

title: Martes y trece
description: Lola and Maria are two Spanish young ladies engaged to Franz and Pepe, all so eager to spend their honeymoon that the moment seems never to come, as all sorts of problems pave their way.

title: Vas-y Coupe!
description: A motley crew of laborers makes the yearly trek to a vineyard in France's Champagne region to pick grapes for a famed winemaker, but as his son begins to take the reins it is unclear if this harvest tradition can endure. A pure vérité portal into two disparate French worlds entwined.

title: Chasing Luck(Y)
description: A man who plays lottery for years suddenly wins 4 million euros, despite his previous lack of success. However, a winning ticket somehow finds its way to the hands of local pub's owners. After finding out that the police and two local crooks are after them, they escape to Greece, but their hosts mistakenly make announcement of the lottery winners over all mediums. From that point, everybody sets out on the way to Greece hoping to find the missing ticket.

title: Oscuro y Lucientes
description: Goya's body remained forgotten in a pantheon in Bordeaux. Decades later, everyone present at the exhumation was greatly surprised: Goya's skull was missing.

title: D*I*Y
description: He fights for wealth. She fights for independence.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

title: Helena y Fernanda
description: An important industrialist suffers a neurosis. In a violent argument he strikes his wife and apparently kills her. Then the body disappears. Criminal melodrama inspired by a similar situation set out by Henri Georges Clouzot in 'Les diaboliques'.

title: 70 Y Pico
description: Grandpa, why did they try to kill you? The documentary addresses the animic changes that the filmmaker experiences while he tries to understand the participation that his grandfather played, as a civil associate, during the last military dictatorship in Argentina. The role that he played as the Dean of the Architecture Faculty at the University of Buenos Aires, as a link with the concentration camp ESMA, is one of the multiple topics that grandpa "Pico" narrates in camera.

title: Perros y Diablos
description: A bank robbery goes wrong, and Cobra is the only one who served time for it. 10 years later, those involved reunite to celebrate his release from prison, but things have changed, and the new gathering of friends turns out to be different.

title: Generation Y
description: A group of ragtag twenty year olds find themselves wanting more out of life in the city of Angels.

title: The Y
description: The Y is a SciFi psychological thriller about a woman with a split soul searching to reconnect before she becomes TheY.

title: YRYR S1-S3
description: A Comedy Series that revolves around the daily lives of the Amusement Club, consisting of Akari Akaza, her childhood friends, Kyoko Toshino and Yui Funami, and her classmate Chinatsu Yoshikawa

title: Las dos y media y... veneno
description: The old Don Senén has squandered in sprees the inheritance of his niece Begoña rather than manage it. There is still a million pesetas, which will only be delivered after the death of Don Senén. To get it, the old man, in complicity with Begoña and two other nephews (Ramón and Marcos) will fake his death. But Ramón and Marcos really planned to poison their uncle putting cyanide in his milk to keep them with money - When poor Quintín, Justo and Paloma (funeral parlor's workers) arise at Don Senén's home they will find an overview full of misunderstandings.

title: Rosas y Espadas
description: Sandra luchó en la batalla en lugar de su padre y fue nombrada Gran General. El emperador quiso concederle un matrimonio, pero ella reveló su identidad femenina. Renunció a su título y regresó a su hogar. Para compensarla, el emperador nombró a su prometido, David. Sin embargo, se casó con Lisa, quien fingía ser la hermana del general. Cuando el reino vuelve a caer en el caos, el canciller Alberto la trajo de vuelta. Al final, los dos alcanzaron sus ideales y se quedaron juntos.

title: Sal y Pimienta
description: A Spanish talk show where the latest scoops of mostly Hispanic pop culture is reported on.

title: Fulano y Mengano
description: The stay in the prison of Eudosio and Carlos, accused unjustly, prevents them from getting a job when they go free. As much as they intend to explain that they were locked up for no reason, nobody will listen to them. So they decide to steal to stay alive. His house is a whole building in ruins, without any closed window and with the walls that are barely standing. Esperanza will try to turn that space into a home, where she works with enthusiasm. But life is very hard and coexistence is also difficult.

title: Locos y Sueltos
description: In the city of Miami Beach came the idea of surprising tourists and messing with the locals routine through uncommon and funny tactics. By showing them spicy situations in which visitors to this sunny city become the stars. "Locos y Sueltos" is born. The show is hosted by Santamonica, whose debut has captivated us all with her refreshing beauty.

title: Cásate y Verás
description: The adventures and misadventures of married couples at different stages of life with humor and laughter.

title: Lucho y Ramos
description: An absentminded burglar is caught in the act by the owner of the house he's stealing.

title: Oro y Polvo
description: The real-life story of a drug cartel leader set to Macbeth.

title: Superagentes y titanes
description: Un importante empresario llega al pais para producir un film con los famosos Titanes.

title: Mariana y Scarlett
description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

title: Apaga... y vámonos
description: A somewhat confused and strange young inventor, named Gustavo, is arrested by the police accused of being a terrorist. Through his statements we will know the truth of the facts. During his childhood he discovers that his father wants to escape to a place called Vesta aboard a spaceship made by himself. However, during the journey he loses his life. Now thirty years old, Gustavo, after a series of events, will try to repeat his father's journey.

title: Y+
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Casada y señorita
description: Jealousy and rivalries in a newly married couple of artists.

title: Traición y renacimiento
description: Hace siete años, Selene, mi hermana menor adoptiva y una delicada omega, atropelló a alguien estando ebria y huyó, derramando sangre en la Frontera del Territorio Humano. Mi padre alfa, mi madre luna y mi hermana biológica me hicieron la misma súplica condescendiente: Selene es una omega, es muy frágil para la prisión. Si va a la Penitenciaría Silvermoon, su loba no sobrevivirá. Lyra, toma su lugar, por favor. Me negué. Pero en una noche de tormenta, mi padre usó su mando absoluto de alfa. Destruyó mi voluntad, controló mi mente y me entregó personalmente al transporte de la prisión. Mi prometido y pareja destinada, Kaelen, el alfa más fuerte de la manada, contuvo su furiosa aura de lobo y me dijo: Lyra, cuando salgas, completaremos el vínculo. Solo resiste estos siete años.

title: Punto y raya
description: "Punto y raya" is the story of a young Colombian recruit who, while patrolling his country's border, is befriended by a Venezuelan adversary, and the tragic consequences of their relationship.

title: Marcelo y María
description: In the sixteenth century, two young indigenous fall in love, but being slaves, they will have to submit to their masters or fight for their love at all cost.

title: Granada y al Paraíso
description: A couple breaks as an imminent end of the world overwhelms these people with unfulfilled goals and unsatisfactory present. Hurrying to take a step before it's over, some assume their lousy employment status, others face panic and depression, and there are those who struggle with their own nonsense Internet exposure, facing loneliness in a city where no one looks sideways.

title: De barro y oro
description: Like so many young people in Spain, Manuel comes to Madrid from his village with the illusion of being a bullfighter. Upon arrival he meets Juan, a flamenco singer older than him and penniless who, together with his friend Lola, will help the boy to get the opportunity to participate in a bullfight on the estate of a famous businessman.

title: Genio y figura
description: When the pregnant Esther gets some bad news from her doctor, he advises her to visit a clinic in Mexico City, so she enlists husband Antonio to drive her there at once, along with her brother Luis. As soon as the men drop her off at the hospital, they hit a local nightclub and live it up, and as they are leaving the club in the company of a sexy dancer, they get thoroughly robbed: the criminals even steal the poor victims' clothes! Taken in to the police station and documented along the way, their photograph turns up in the paper the next day, which Esther of course sees. The men will have a lot to explain when they arrive at the clinic to pick up Esther.

title: Y si ella volviera
description: Sonia, a school teacher, is excited about her new post in the Cuban beach town of Caibarien since her childhood friend Guillermo lives there. However she finds Guillermo a tormented soul and evil lurks in town.

title: Sol y Luna
description: During research for a documentary about migrants, Javier finds himself in a love dilemma, trapped between a Spanish girl and a Dominican one.

title: Susana y el sexo
description: Susana Estrada was the first artist in Spain to perform a full nude on stage, a striptease, assuming its innumerable consequences. Her constant involvement with the subject of sex cost her the suspension of her passport and the right to vote. Looking at the past through Susana's story is also looking at a Spain that repressed women, a struggle that still lasts today.

title: Agus y Lui, Churros y Crafts
Cuba canta y baila
description: A family of peasants win a lottery prize and must travel to Havana in order to claim it. They are amazed at all the musical entertainment in the big city but ignore that their lottery winnings are in danger.

title: Manuel y Clemente
description: Manuel and Clemente, couple in the shower and in various scheming, try to do business with miraculous apparitions. Near the Sevillian town of El Palmar de Troya, in 1968, people begin to say that the Virgin appears and the two friends take advantage of the situation. Soon a network of economic interests and credulity is created that makes it easier for Manuel and Clemente to achieve their goal: a monumental basilica, a religious order of nuns, priests and bishops of their own, and even a pope, Gregory XVII. Satire on the curious origin of the Palmarian Catholic Church and its unique founders.

title: Las detectivas y el Víctor
description: A married couple creates a detective agency.

title: Mi marido y sus complejos
description: A married man can't stand his mother-in-law and lives every day waiting for the night. That's when he gets the chance to let his hair down, go to a night club and escape from the monotony of his family life.

title: Susana y Elvira, La Serie
description: 'Susana and Elvira' is a web series that emerged from a blog that two young people created in 2008 to talk with total freedom about sex, relationships, and other everyday aspects of their life in relation to men.

title: Malá z rybárny
description: Everyone's familiar with Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid, the story of a love capable of forgiving even the greatest betrayal. title: Dziennik z podrózy
description: Tadeusz Rolke, an aged master of Polish photography, has more than just a typical teacher-student relationship with 15-year-old Michal. Together, they travel across Poland to take portrait photographs of the residents of small towns and villages while the dark room placed in their camper enables them to develop pictures on the spot and give them to the models whom they meet accidentally. For the boy, this is an excellent opportunity to find out about the arcana of traditional photography. For both - an opportunity to experience a beautiful friendship.

title: Zero Position
description:
An experiential journey through the war in Eastern Ukraine along the ideological borderland between East and West, Zero Position explores the intricate layers of hidden powers that shape the conflict before the 2022 Russian invasion. Introducing civilians and combatants on both sides, who are numbed and shattered by the ongoing conflict, the film explores stark realities and sheds light on a country with dueling identities, wherein loyalty to one ideology or the other can result in either survival or demise.

After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, Ukraine declared independence. In 2014 pro-Russian separatists declared independence from Ukraine in two small regions in Eastern Ukraine, Luhansk and Donetsk. War then broke out between Ukrainian and Russian backed separatist forces, and a 450 km static frontline was established in Eastern Ukraine. Cities, coal mines, power plants, and steel mills are on the frontline in a region that was once the industrial heartland of the Soviet Union. Thousands have been killed, wounded, and displaced. Crucial infrastructure such as bridges have been destroyed to cut off access to separatist territory, segregated civilians from resources they had formerly relied upon. Meanwhile countless land mines and unexploded bombs litter the landscape, making daily travel a routinely precarious affair.

Director and journalist Louie Palu serves as a surrogate for the viewer, navigating ruined landscapes to have honest and unmediated conversations with civilians and combatants alike, illuminating the psychic impacts of the ongoing conflict on the populace. The film takes viewers on tours through strategic sites such as power stations and the Azovstal steel mill in Mariupol that was the focus of Russian attacks early in the invasion. We are even allowed to sit with families and hear their thoughts on the conflict, the ideologies behind it, and the way it is shaping the lives of children.

Zero Position reveals the reality of desperation, institutional decay, personal trauma, and slave-like working conditions often hidden from the West by a patchwork of legacy Cold War controls related to state security and an inability for most journalists to report there and reach Western audiences.

title: 7 minuti
description: The owners of an Italian textile factory sell the majority of the property to a multinational company. No layoffs are planned, but there's a special clause in the agreement that the new owner wants the council to sign. Eleven women representing the whole factory will have to decide whether to accept the company's request or not. The debate turns on, and the stories of the women, made of hopes and memories, will emerge before the final vote.

title: Room 7
description: Homeless retiree Mike Richards, 70, moves into a hostel (temporary shared accommodation) whilst he waits for the council to find him somewhere permanent to live. Horrified to discover a refugee family already living there he initially returns to sleep on the streets, but eventually chooses the run down house and its current occupants. The family consisting of husband and wife, Jan and Su, both 35, and their two children Seher, 6, and baby Rodi have been living there for three years alongside a teenage Somali boy, Aaden.

description: MOTO7: A film that rewrites the moto playbook, with the biggest jumps, the gnarliest tracks, and some of the most remote locations a motorcycle has ever touched. Experience Blake Baggett's newly-developed El Chupacabra Ranch in Florida, one of the most gargantuan home tracks ever made, where Baggett and Ken Roczen enjoy a daily routine of riding light speed fast laps with an almost lackadaisical ease. Three miles away, Aldon Baker trains factory superstars Ryan Dungey, Marvin Musqin and Jason Anderson on a program fit for Seal Team Six. Then there's the Smokey Mountains in Idaho, where the Sipes brothers Ryan and Justin go to feel the sweet serenity of a man, his motorcycle, and countless miles of natural single-track. All of these riders are taking moto to territories it has never seen, be that on the stopwatch or the trail map. There's Colton Haaker, the Endurocross phenom whose bike-control and technical abilities are that of superhuman levels. Then of course, Justin Barcia, the exemplar of style on a motocross bike, the guy who defies logic and rides with an amount of panache and flamboyance that is shunned in professional motocross, yet somehow has climbed to the top of the sport.

title: AD Bugi
description: Without assistant directors (A.D.s), there would be no television programs, yet this demanding job pays little and allows almost no private time. and having a girlfriend is next to impossible. Nevertheless, the dream of one day becoming a director drives the young men of this series to take on more hardship, and risk more at love, than most other people their age.

title: Markus Raetz

title: Egg
description: A father and son sell eggs. The father meets a woman his son's age and although the son is against it, they get married and the boy leaves home.

title: Rotonda
description: Beginning at the break of dawn and ending the next morning, the story, set around a rugged city intersection, follows the path of a marked one-thousand-peso bill as it transfers from one character to another, returning to its originator in the end, blood-tainted. The money leads us to each of the five offbeat characters, all in desperate need of their soul's redemption: a disillusioned tabloid reporter planning to commit suicide in a motel, a nightclub dancer con prostitute who has avowed to give her kid sister a better life, a fallen henchman resurfacing to score big time, a chronic runaway teenage girl held captive as sex slave by a cop, and a long-suffering son bearing a sadomasochistic relationship with his brutish, half-paralyzed father who behaves like a mad dictator in his wheelchair. Like a ticking time bomb, the story unravels with unforgiving immediacy and explodes in the end with a tabloid front-pager triple homicide where death seems to have come full circle.

title: Happy Family
description: Thijs is a ripe-age Dutch tomato grower. His adult daughters plan to have him move in a skyscraper-flat, leaving home and professional life, but he takes his adolescent (half-)Moroccon grandson Omar's advice to refuse and keep living. Thijs even lets the cheerful rascal coach his love-life, which lands him on a blind date with Jacky, an energetic Flemish woman, who won't take no for an answer but turns up at his door-step till he consents, and soon drags him into evening life, preparing for a dance contest. Soon after Omar turns up, listless and lazier then ever, runaway from school and home. The obvious reason for the horny hound's hanging head is a girl: Mergal is foxy, Turkish and as smitten as he, but her burly big brother Erhan will only allow a boy to go steady with her who has proven himself his better on the field in the traditional manly sport of oil-wrestling. Now Thijs, in his day a 'dry' wrestler, resolves to return the kid's favor by coaching down-beaten Omar back to life to the full, although the decisive match is in a few days, like the contest, and the unathletic novice pupil still has nothing to show for his cockiness...

title: Klem in de draaideur

title: Full of the Void: Vacui ad Plenum

title: XMIX
description: In each episode, lazy Duch police constable Anton gets a task from his sergeant. Always preoccupied with domestic matters and other problems raised by his girl-friend, Antone keeps passing those cases on to Xmix, a trio of unworldly video-game heroes, which come to life during each investigation.

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock

title: Peach of Time
description: Peach, a 22-year old Thai boy, takes a daring step in his life and decides to fly to Korea to meet his online Korean friend, Yun Oh. Everything seems perfect for Peach. He finally realized his dream. On top of that, as he stays in his friend's house, the two can finally be together. But something just doesn't seem right. Sung Suk, Yun Oh's mother, seems to be cautious and reserved in Peach's presence. She is harsh with her son and Peach soon realizes that the two do not get along well. Willing to help his friend, Peach takes matters in his own hands and tries to mend the strained relationship. He just wants Yun Oh to be happy - and if he can make it happen, he will. But what is that weird feeling in Peach's heart? Does he like Yun Oh...?
